I’m Evrin from the Wayfinders Guild.
You've become quite famous in Babylon.
To maintain that reputation, I'd like you to assist our novice Adventurers. Please bring back monster blood from the {PlaceParam}. With a bit of refining, it can be used as medicine.

Name: Lv.{LevelParam} The Olmu Merchants' Dilemma
DescNotCompleted:
We're the Olmu Merchants of the Merchants Guild.
We can procure whatever you require. However, we have run into a bit of a problem lately. 
We haven't been able to receive our shipments due to the monsters appearing from the {PlaceParam}.
We would be grateful if you could eliminate them, Adventurer.

Name: Lv.{LevelParam} The Olmu Merchants' Dilemma
DescNotCompleted:
We're the Olmu Merchants of the Merchants Guild.
We can procure whatever you require. But our troubles simply never seem to end.
We're short on supplies again because of the monsters appearing at the {PlaceParam}.
Please clear them out for us, Adventurer.

Name: Lv.{LevelParam} The Olmu Merchants' Dilemma
DescNotCompleted:
We're the Olmu Merchants of the Merchants Guild.
We can procure whatever you require. It's going to be a disaster if we miss the delivery date, but we can't receive our goods because of the monsters appearing in the {PlaceParam}.
It would be great if you could clear them out for us, Adventurer.

Name: Lv.{LevelParam} Pedido de Zariya, comerciante geral
DescNotCompleted:
Há tempos não nos vemos, aventureiro!
Já somos próximos o bastante para trocar favores, não acha?
Preciso de ossos de monstros de {PlaceParam}. Você pode trazê-los para mim? Não se preocupe com a recompensa: vou pagar direitinho.

I’m Kanber, the dispatcher from the Wayfinders Guild.
I am contacting you regarding some unusual monster activity.
We are out of red flares, and I fear for the safety of our novice Adventurers. 
It would be so helpful if you could get rid of the monsters at the {PlaceParam}.

Name: Lv.{LevelParam} The Price of Fame
DescNotCompleted:
I’m Evrin from the Wayfinders Guild.
You've become quite famous in Babylon.
To maintain that reputation, I'd like you to assist our novice Adventurers. Please bring back monster blood from the {PlaceParam}. With a bit of refining, it can be used as medicine.

I am Henrik.
The one who actually keeps the Blacksmiths Guild running.
Ugh, don’t even bring up my brother. Just the thought of that man gives me a headache. Anyway, I need you to handle something for me. Go and clear out those monsters running wild at the {PlaceParam}. We can't forge a thing without Istarium, now can we?

Name: Lv.{LevelParam} Developing a Sense of Beauty
DescNotCompleted:
I am Fabrice, Master of the Artisans Guild.
An eye for true beauty is a rare gift.
As you can see, the Forsaken Land is home to many peculiar beasts. Some find them grotesque, but I seek the hidden beauty within.
Please bring me a specimen of the monsters from the {PlaceParam}. But keep this between us. Not a word to Maureen.

Sou Dana, da Explorers Guild.
As histórias compartilhadas entre aventureiros se tornam registros valiosos.

DescNotCompleted:

I am Henrik.
The one who actually keeps the Blacksmiths Guild running.
Ugh, don’t even bring up my brother. Just the thought of that man gives me a headache. Anyway, I need you to handle something for me. Go and clear out those monsters running wild at the {PlaceParam}. We can't forge a thing without Istarium, now can we?

Name: Lv.{LevelParam} Developing a Sense of Beauty
DescNotCompleted:
I am Fabrice, Master of the Artisans Guild.
An eye for true beauty is a rare gift.
As you can see, the Forsaken Land is home to many peculiar beasts. Some find them grotesque, but I seek the hidden beauty within.
Please bring me a specimen of the monsters from the {PlaceParam}. But keep this between us. Not a word to Maureen.

We haven't been able to receive our shipments due to the monsters appearing from the {PlaceParam}.
We would be grateful if you could eliminate them, Adventurer.

We haven't been able to receive our shipments due to the monsters appearing from the {PlaceParam}.

DescNotCompleted:

We can procure whatever you require. But our troubles simply never seem to end.
We're short on supplies again because of the monsters appearing at the {PlaceParam}.
Please clear them out for us, Adventurer.

Name: Lv.{LevelParam} The Olmu Merchants' Dilemma
DescNotCompleted:

That bald idiot... Is he seriously dumping more work on me? Again?!
Ugh... Hey, you! You there, sturdy-looking human! Yes, you!
You're doing Baldy's errand for me. We need to build up your stamina first, so go and take out every, and I mean EVERY monster at the {PlaceParam}!

DescNotCompleted:
I am Henrik.
The one who actually keeps the Blacksmiths Guild running.
Ugh, don’t even bring up my brother. Just the thought of that man gives me a headache. Anyway, I need you to handle something for me. Go and clear out those monsters running wild at the {PlaceParam}. We can't forge a thing without Istarium, now can we?

Name: Lv.{LevelParam} The Olmu Merchants' Dilemma
DescNotCompleted:
We're the Olmu Merchants of the Merchants Guild.
We can procure whatever you require. However, we have run into a bit of a problem lately. 
We haven't been able to receive our shipments due to the monsters appearing from the {PlaceParam}.
We would be grateful if you could eliminate them, Adventurer.

DescNotCompleted:

We can procure whatever you require. But our troubles simply never seem to end.
We're short on supplies again because of the monsters appearing at the {PlaceParam}.
Please clear them out for us, Adventurer.

Name: Lv.{LevelParam} The Olmu Merchants' Dilemma

It would be great if you could clear them out for us, Adventurer.

So, start by taking down the monsters at the {PlaceParam}. That’s where it all begins!

It’s me, Monica. You’re going to do a little work with me.

Name: Lv.{LevelParam} Establishing Secure Routes

I won't let my research be held up by mere monsters. So please, get a move on.

So, start by taking down the monsters at the {PlaceParam}. That’s where it all begins!

It's Koon.
Did I mention I’m with the Hunters Guild?
As you've seen, these monsters have been causing quite a mess lately.
If you're not too busy, go and take care of those monsters at the {PlaceParam} for me, my friend!

Name: Lv.{LevelParam} The Hunt for Romance
DescNotCompleted:
It’s me, darling.
I'm supposed to be on a 'romantic hunt,' but I'm just not feeling it all by myself.
Could you please bring me some samples of monsters from the {PlaceParam}?
After all, nothing fills an empty heart like the memories we share.
Come, let's go on a hunt for romance again.

Name: Center of the Guild
DescNotCompleted: Aman tells the Adventurer about the Adventurers Alliance and the Merchants Guild.

Name: An Eye for Talent
DescNotCompleted: Aman advises meeting the Masters of the Explorers and Appraisers Guilds.

Name: A Discerning Eye
DescNotCompleted: Aman suggets purchasing a Sacred Relic.

Name: A Request with a Reward
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer sets out to rescue a merchant caravan stranded in the Giant’s Corridor at Aman’s request.

Name: Inter-species Collaboration
DescNotCompleted:
The Adventurer helps Jamira and Bruno.
The Adventurer is treated to a rare experience, making snacks for Rappie awaits…

Name: Judging by the Cover
DescNotCompleted:
The Adventurer collects Istarium at Henrik’s request.
only to be greeted by a man with a menacing scowl.

Name: A Gentle Heart Beneath
DescNotCompleted:
The Adventurer is unfazed by Thorstein’s appearance.
Henrik pulls the Adventurer aside to explain the workings of the Commission House.

Name: Shameless Promotion
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer earns a Weapon Enhancement Stone Recipe as a reward for spreading the word for the Blacksmiths Guild at Thorstein’s request.

Name: Take Responsibility for Your Words
DescNotCompleted:
Thorstein suggests meeting his prized apprentice, Armia.
But after a ‘mysterious trial,’ the Adventurer stands at the verge of taking on a serious responsibility.

Name: The Break for Freedom
DescNotCompleted:
After completing the enhancement, the Adventurer decides that it’s time to escape.
If the Adventurer does not leave the Blacksmiths Guild immediately, they might just end up sharing Armia’s fate!

Name: Fists Faster Than Coins
DescNotCompleted: Morien from the Artisans Guild needs help tracking down a merchant who took the money and ran.

Name: Drowning in Inspiration
DescNotCompleted: Morien takes extreme measures to drag Fabrice, the Master of the Artisans Guild, back from a sea of his own inspiration.

Name: How to Block a Burst Dam?
DescNotCompleted:
Fabris reflects too late, but the guild members have already gone their separate ways.
The Adventurer lends a hand to restore the Artisans’ Guild to its former glory.

Name: The One Who Never Learned to Say No
DescNotCompleted:
Never knowing when to quit, Fabris sets out once more to find the guild members.
But again, the result is…

Name: Who is the Guild Master?
DescNotCompleted:
Locate the cat that caused all sorts of trouble that eventually made Fabris go back to his senses.
After chasing the cat, the Adventurer finally encounters Maureen.

Name: Stupidity is Incurable
DescNotCompleted:
Monica, the Master of the Appraisers’ Guild, urgently offers an “assistant” position.
But wait, all the guild members have run away?

Name: In Search of the Missing Courier
DescNotCompleted:
The courier who signed a contract with Monica to deliver artifacts left Babylon as if being chased,
and Monica cannot contain her rage, saying one is missing.

Name: An Untouched Place
DescNotCompleted:
One must not simply sit and wait for artifacts; one must go out and find them.
For that is the true beginning of “Artifact Appraisal.”

Name: Feet Without Footprints
DescNotCompleted:
Clearly, there’s no sign of anyone working here.
Nevertheless, the measuring tools are detecting Aether.

Name: Discovering One’s Talent
DescNotCompleted:
Joar’s talent shines in unexpected situations.
What kind of work will he do in the future?

Name: Please Take Charge of the Hunters Guild
DescNotCompleted:
It seems the Hunters’ Guild is home to some truly free spirits.
Even the Guild Master makes an extraordinary proposal to the Adventurer...

Name: There is a Right Way to Hunt
DescNotCompleted: After finding the first troubled guild member in the wastes, the Adventurer decides to show them what true skill looks like.

Name: I Capture because I Care
DescNotCompleted:
It’s a mystery why this particular hunter is even in the Hunters’ Guild.
How exactly do they define “hunting?”

Name: A Hunter Uses Any Tool at Hand
DescNotCompleted:
The last troubled hunter seems to move with firm convictions.
They insist on not being disturbed, regardless of what happens to the guild...

Name: People Unite in the Face of a Crisis
DescNotCompleted:
Whatever their reasons, the hunters definitely do not want to be expelled.
Will they somehow be able to achieve unity?

Name: Know-how of the Experienced
DescNotCompleted: Evrin asks the Adventurer to recommend items for a beginner’s survival bag.

Name: Something You Can Never Have Too Much Of
DescNotCompleted:
Evrin emphasizes the importance of Gold for surviving in the Forsaken Land.
Following her advice, the Adventurer sets out to find gold.

Name: Knowledge Is Power
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer learns that the “Arbiter’s Ordeal” is actually an ancient treasure vault.

Name: A Breaking Point from the Past
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer discovers that the Grace of the constellations Card grows through the power of stars.

Name: There’s Strength in Numbers
DescNotCompleted:
Evrin encourages clan activities and suggests meeting Ragnar.
After hearing Ragnar’s advice, the Adventurer begins a challenge to draw people’s attention.

Name: Accidental Fixer
DescNotCompleted: Evrin of the Wayfinders Guild calls for the adventurer to briefly check in, and then requests an investigation into the Perpetual Corridor.

Name: The Lucky One
DescNotCompleted: Kaila explains the Perpetual Corridor to the protagonist, who then takes her potion to find Naruru Etana in Aburu Village.

Name: Abnormal Signal
DescNotCompleted: Evrin finds the adventurer, explains that the currents beneath the tower are out of the ordinary, and introduces Asli.

Name: Tangled World
DescNotCompleted: Having learned of the connection between the tower and Aether, the adventurer heads to the tower’s basement with Asli’s help.

Name: Rumo a Forsaken Land
DescNotCompleted: O aventureiro recebe uma carta de Ingel, comandante dos Sverd Mercenaries, e entra em Forsaken Land.
DescCompleted: O aventureiro quase morre ao enfrentar uma entidade desconhecida. Depois, segue para Babylon com Rada, que conheceu no labirinto.

Name: A Wayfinders Guild de Babylon
DescNotCompleted: O aventureiro chega com Rada a Babylon, a grande cidade destas terras desoladas. Eles procuram pistas sobre o grupo de mercenários na Wayfinders Guild.
DescCompleted: O aventureiro explora Babylon com Rada e compra suprimentos básicos de sobrevivência seguindo o conselho de Evrin, responsável pela guilda.

Name: Viaje com facilidade e rapidez
DescNotCompleted: Evrin apresenta uma maneira de viajar com facilidade por Forsaken Land.
DescCompleted: Sob a orientação de Rada, o aventureiro registra um Greater Warp Anchor.

Name: Negociando com a Merchants Guild
DescNotCompleted: Evrin recomenda uma visita à Merchants Guild para descobrir o paradeiro do grupo de mercenários.
DescCompleted: O aventureiro conhece Aman, líder da Merchants Guild. A pedido de Rada, Aman promete investigar o paradeiro dos mercenários.

Name: Ragnar, o Divine
DescNotCompleted: O aventureiro conhece Ragnar, um dos Divines reverenciados como heróis de Forsaken Land.
DescCompleted: O aventureiro e Rada detêm a incursão em Firststride Village.

Name: Joyful Children
DescNotCompleted: While Rada gathers new information, Village Representative Uzar explains the ambitious reconstruction project.
DescCompleted: At Uzar's request, the Adventurer finds and rescues the children hiding from the Incursion.

Name: Firststride Village's Resurgence
DescNotCompleted: Uzar explains that the area surrounding the village is too dangerous to tend even a small garden.
DescCompleted: The Adventurer helps Uzar by collecting soil for land clearing and eliminating monsters.

Name: Clearing the Steel Bison
DescNotCompleted: Uzar asks the Adventurer to eliminate the monsters near the water to prepare for full-scale land clearing.
DescCompleted: After eliminating the Steel Bison, the Adventurer hears that Rada has returned.

Name: To the Sunshade Encampment
DescNotCompleted: Rada proudly announces she has secured information about the Sverd Mercenaries.
DescCompleted: Following Rada's advice, the Adventurer sets off to find the 'Incursion Solver', heading to the location of a recent sighting.

Name: Kamyar's Lost Luggage
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer meets the peddler Kamyar on the way to the Sunshade Encampment.
DescCompleted: The Adventurer rescues the peddler's precious wedding anniversary gift.

Name: Xeros's Whereabouts
DescNotCompleted: Upon arriving at the destination, the Adventurer asks around for the Incursion Solver, Xeros.
DescCompleted: The Adventurer gains little useful information from the people staying at the encampment.

Name: Days at the Encampment
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer helps resolve issues around the encampment while waiting for Xeros's informant.
DescCompleted:
The Adventurer helps Keyvan and Yasta at the encampment.
When is Tabana coming back, anyway?

Name: Reunion Beyond the Bridge
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer heads to the bridge in front of the encampment to meet Tabana.
DescCompleted: The Adventurer finally meets Xeros, who was holding back the Incursion.

Name: Artificial Incursion
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer learns that Xeros is in the same situation as they are.
DescCompleted: Xeros mentions that the mercenaries took the lead in containing the Incursion and suggests that Commander Ingel might be at the site.

Name: The Courage to Overcome Fear
DescNotCompleted: While heading to the Bardad Expedition Garrison, the Adventurer meets Baran, an expedition member in distress.
DescCompleted: The Adventurer helps Baran by gathering Evening Primroses for him.

Name: She Knows
DescNotCompleted: Mentioning his fear of flying, Baran once again seeks the Adventurer's help.
DescCompleted: The Adventurer delivers the report and flowers to Expedition Member Olia in Baran's stead.

Name: How to Overcome Sorrow
DescNotCompleted: Olia asks the Adventurer if they would like to do one more good deed.
DescCompleted: The Adventurer sets up a signpost for Ushan, an expedition member waiting for his younger sibling. In return, Ushan reveals the Expedition Leader's location.

Name: A Commission in Return
DescNotCompleted: Expedition Leader Bardad asks for help investigating the sudden Incursion.
DescCompleted: The Adventurer eliminates monsters at the Ancient Ruins Excavation Site to investigate the Incursion.

Name: Remnants of the Incursion
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer collects Tesseract Fragments at Bardad's request.
DescCompleted: Bardad states that the Tesseract Fragments are likely related to the recent Incursions that occurred without warning.

Name: Observatory Inspection
DescNotCompleted: Bardad explains the Observatory's functions and requests an investigation.
DescCompleted: The Adventurer spots suspicious individuals while investigating the Observatory. Bardad suspects they are the Shadow Wolves.

Name: Holy Beretta
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer asks Beretta, one of the Divines, to repair the Observatory parts.
DescCompleted: While repairing the Observatory parts, Beretta orders the Adventurer to find the Record Disc.

Name: Visiting the Asientet Legation
DescNotCompleted: As thanks for helping with the investigation, Bardad provides a letter of introduction and recommends visiting the Asientet Legation, where they might find clues about the mercenaries.
DescCompleted: Muina, Adjutant of the Asientet Legation, sends the Adventurer to the Central Detachment Garrison, promising that she will look into the mercenaries' whereabouts.

Name: The Missing Transport Unit
DescNotCompleted: Detachment Commander Nazir starts bossing the Adventurer around as soon as he checks the orders.
DescCompleted:
The Adventurer investigates the whereabouts of the transport unit.
However, there were no sign of dead soldiers or the transported goods.

Name: Outlaws of the Barrens
DescNotCompleted: Nazir orders the Adventurer to find and wipe out the Shadow Wolves.
DescCompleted:
The Adventurer defeats the Shadow Wolves near the White-Bone Expanse.
However, Nazir does not look pleased.

Name: Khoon, the Divine
DescNotCompleted: Khoon the Divine appears, calling out the Detachment Commander's negligence, and pretends to know the Adventurer.
DescCompleted: Khoon pulls the Adventurer away from Nazir under the guise of securing the roads.

Name: Hunter's Intuition
DescNotCompleted: Sensing something amiss, Khoon tells the Adventurer to tail the Stash keeper heading towards the White-Bone Expanse.
DescCompleted: The Adventurer catches the Stash keeper colluding with the Shadow Wolves. Khoon mentions a power struggle between the Legate and the Adjutant, advising the Adventurer to steer clear of the matter...

Name: A Shallow Trick
DescNotCompleted: Detachment Commander Nazir orders the Adventurer to find the missing soldiers.
DescCompleted:
The Adventurer encounters the Shadow Wolves while searching for the missing soldiers.
Khoon is convinced this is a trap.

Name: The Turbulent Barrens
DescNotCompleted: Upon returning to the Legation, the Adventurer is caught in a sudden, warningless Incursion just as Muina is about to share news of the mercenaries.
DescCompleted: Muina asks for the Divines' assistance. The Adventurer stops the Incursion alongside the Divines.

Name: Unending Incursion
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer stops the Incursion under Ragnar's command.
DescCompleted: With time running out, the Adventurer fights desperately to quell the Incursion.

Name: Resolving the Incursion
DescNotCompleted: The Incursion is temporarily halted thanks to the Adventurer and the Divine. Ragnar asks them to inform the Legation.
DescCompleted: The Adventurer tells Muina that they have resolved the Incursions that occurred simultaneously across the Barrens.

Name: The Outlaws' Ambush
DescNotCompleted: Muina reports that the Shadow Wolves have struck amidst the chaos of the Incursion, and asks the Adventurer for help once again.
DescCompleted: The Adventurer informs Muina of the Shadow Wolves' assassination attempt.

Name: Asientet Legate Fahad
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer is granted an audience with Fahad, the Legate of the Asientet Legation.
DescCompleted:
The Adventurer nervously faces Fahad.
Fortunately, the incident Muina feared does not occur.

Name: A New Clue
DescNotCompleted: After receiving intel about the mercenary named Simon from Aman, the leader of the Merchants Guild, the Adventurer heads to the Magobi Encampment in the western Barrens.
DescCompleted: The Adventurer purchases a stamina potion for Bishan on their way to the Magobi Encampment.

Name: The Blocked Path
DescNotCompleted: Arriving at the Magobi Encampment, the Adventurer cooperates with the safety measures.
DescCompleted: The Adventurer meets Bishan, who asks them to help the Naruru Tribe trading with the merchant guild.

Name: Where is Azid?
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer and Jiranna of the Naruru Tribe seek Detachment Commander Jeihan's help.
DescCompleted: Jeihan grants a permit to allow Jiranna and the Adventurer to search for Azid.

Name: Long Sought After
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer searches the gorge with Jiranna to find Azid.
DescCompleted: The Adventurer hears a familiar voice echoing in the gorge. It belongs to the mercenary Simon.

Name: Bandit Ambush
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer helps Jeihan and the soldiers fend off the bandits who raided the encampment.
DescCompleted: Jeihan and Jiranna express their gratitude to the Adventurer for wiping out the Shadow Wolves.

Name: To the Taima Pioneer Village
DescNotCompleted: While crossing the gorge to the Taima Pioneer Village, the Adventurer meets a resident who seems to be in trouble.
DescCompleted: The Adventurer escorts the resident to the Taima Pioneer Village, eliminating the dangerous monsters blocking their path.

Name: What the Pioneer Village Needs
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer heads to the Taima Pioneer Village with the resident. They briefly admire the beautiful scenery.
DescCompleted: The resident brings the Adventurer to Kamiya, noting that she would know just about everything.

Name: The Jabar Merchant Guild's Rearguard
DescNotCompleted: Kamiya suggests that the Adventurer look around the village while she brings Simon.
DescCompleted: The Adventurer meets a Naruru on a rooftop and helps Tirash look for Azid's friend, Enju.

Name: The Informants' Whereabouts
DescNotCompleted: Kamiya hurriedly finds the Adventurer and reports that Simon has disappeared and the accompanying pioneer informant has been murdered.
DescCompleted: While investigating the truth behind the incident, the Adventurer encounters Shadow Wolf Clan members and stops the Incursion they caused.

Name: The Spreading Threat
DescNotCompleted: Upon hearing the report from the pioneer village, Aman and the Adventurer notify the Divines.
DescCompleted: The Divines decide to eradicate the Shadow Wolves and recover the Tesseract. Ragnar asks the Adventurer to move out with Azlan.

Name: A Familiar Face
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer and Azlan join forces—the Adventurer to find Simon, and Azlan to annihilate the Shadow Wolves.
DescCompleted: With the help of Jiranna and the Jabar Merchant Guild, the Adventurer and Azlan arrive at the Giant's Garden.

Name: Giant's Garden
DescNotCompleted: Jiranna advises the Adventurer and Azlan to ask 'Stoutbeard Etura' of Aburu Village for help.
DescCompleted:
The two track down Stoutbeard's whereabouts.
However, Etura seems quite troubled by their request.

Name: The Unfolding Truth
DescNotCompleted: The two begin tracking the missing Naruru Tribe members.
DescCompleted: The Adventurer and Azlan discover that the missing Naruru Tribe members are being held captive by the Shadow Wolves.

Name: A Promise of Cooperation
DescNotCompleted: Azlan promises Etura that he will save the Naruru Tribe.
DescCompleted: The Adventurer, Azlan, and even the Naruru Tribe join forces to defeat the Shadow Wolves and discover their hideout.

Name: Wolf Hunt
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer begins searching the hideout for Simon, while Azlan seeks his revenge.
DescCompleted: Simon passes away, and Azlan finally slays his long-time enemy, the leader of the Shadow Wolves.

Name: Dispelling the Shadows
DescNotCompleted: After the battle with the Shadow Wolf Clan Leader, Azran and the Adventurer gather evidence to track down the remaining members.
DescCompleted: The two discover a secret letter sent by the Paradise Advent Society. While Azran conducts further investigation, the Adventurer escorts the Naruru tribe back to the village.

Name: A Festival of Taste and Flavors
DescNotCompleted: Etura intends to proceed with the festival, which had been postponed due to a series of incidents.
DescCompleted: While helping the Naruru tribe prepare for the festival, the Adventurer reunites with Rada.

Name: The Case of the Missing Offerings
DescNotCompleted: ‘Isimu’, the Tribute Keeper, asks for help claiming that the offerings have vanished. The Adventurer and Rada head to the location where the offerings were lost.
DescCompleted: The Adventurer and Rada do their best to find the offerings, but they cannot find even a single trace.

Name: Thieves Are Always Near
DescNotCompleted: Rada suspects that the Kuduru tribe is behind the theft of the offerings.
DescCompleted: The Adventurer defeats the Kuduru Tribe near the Three-Way Waterfall and reclaims the tribute.

Name: The Festival Begins!
DescNotCompleted: Rada and the Adventurer return to the village with the tribute.
DescCompleted: After enjoying the festival with Rada, the Adventurer sets out to meet Xeros.

Name: A Tough Way to Make a Living
DescNotCompleted: Etura mentions that clues about Xeros and the Paradise Advent Society can be found at the Cactus Nest.
DescCompleted: On the way to the Cactus Nest, the Adventurer meets a strange ecologist named Monas.

Name: I Protect the Nest
DescNotCompleted: Monas recommends meeting Bahista, the Squad Leader of the Bardad Expedition.
DescCompleted: The Adventurer discovers that wild animals near the Cactus Nest are showing abnormal symptoms after consuming Aetherium.

Name: Unknown Frenzy
DescNotCompleted: Eventually, people also begin collapsing after consuming Aetherium.
DescCompleted: The Adventurer and the Bristly-Hair Karadu try to uncover the truth while healing the afflicted.

Name: Endless Pain
DescNotCompleted: However, despite various treatments, the people show no signs of recovery.
DescCompleted: While everyone is focused on healing, news of a sudden Incursion arrives.

Name: Deeply Tinted Grassland
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer clears out the Incursion with the Bristly-Hairs.
DescCompleted: After dealing with the Incursion, the Adventurer hears the sorrowful cry of a Rappie. Karadu asks them to take the Rappie to the ranch.

Name: A Troubled Ranch
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer heads to the Rappie Ranch with the Rappie.
DescCompleted: The Adventurer helps Rancher Barashu with work disrupted by the Incursion.

Name: Rappie Rescue Operation
DescNotCompleted: Almost done. The Adventurer brings back the Rappie found near the Kuduru Tribe.
DescCompleted: The Adventurer carefully rescues all the Rappies while defeating nearby Monsters.

Name: How to Soothe Children
DescNotCompleted: The Kuduru Tribe raids the ranch once again.
DescCompleted: The Adventurer stops the Kuduru Tribe by helping the Naruru Tribe protect the land given to them by Ea.

Name: Unfading Threat
DescNotCompleted: A peddler looking to buy Rappies demands the elimination of the Kuduru Tribe in exchange for information about the Incursion fixer.
DescCompleted: The peddler informs them that Xeros went to Kuduru's Domain.

Name: The Frontline
DescNotCompleted: Heading to Kuduru's Domain, the Adventurer encounters Sharaf and Mitchell in the middle of an argument.
DescCompleted: Mitchell goes out of his way to help the Adventurer search for the Incursion Specialist. While Mitchell is away, the Adventurer inspects the Encampment.

Name: Exterminate the Kuduru Tribe
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer decides to wipe out the Kuduru Tribe to ease Sharaf's suspicions.
DescCompleted: While Mitchell looks for the Naruru Tribe to gather information on the Incursion fixer, the Adventurer reunites with Khoon.

Name: A Ward Under the Tree
DescNotCompleted: While Khoon is also tracking Xeros, the Adventurer asks Tyuri of the Hunters Guild where Mitchell went.
DescCompleted: The Adventurer gathers medicinal herbs for Baragur, a Naruru injured while fighting the Kuduru Tribe.

Name: Shadow Over the Incursion
DescNotCompleted: While the Adventurer asks Sharaf about Mitchell's whereabouts, an Incursion suddenly occurs.
DescCompleted: The Adventurer reunites with Xeros at the site of the Incursion. Xeros, swinging his sword at Mitchell, claims he caused the Incursion.

Name: Long-Awaited Reunion
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer moves to a different place to speak with Xeros.
DescCompleted: Following Xeros's suggestion, the Adventurer operates a bizarre device and experiences a strange memory.

Name: The Brewery's Old Customer
DescNotCompleted: Xeros tells the Adventurer to meet him after resting at the brewery.
DescCompleted: The Adventurer arrives at the brewery and encounters Beretta.

Name: A Frustrating Naruru Master
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer and Beretta examine the abnormal symptoms of Ishinu's disciples.
DescCompleted: The Adventurer follows Beretta to check on Tristan, Joris, and Denny.

Name: Medicinal Herbs in Dangerous Places
DescNotCompleted: Beretta asks the Adventurer to fetch medicinal herbs to treat the disciples.
DescCompleted: The Adventurer heads behind the brewery, clearing the way by defeating wild animals.

Name: Colorful Flowers Harbor Poison
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer gathers medicinal herbs in earnest.
DescCompleted: The Adventurer returns to the brewery after gathering enough ingredients for the cure.

Name: Craft the Antidote
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer helps Beretta craft a cure using the gathered herbs and the ingredients she provided.
DescCompleted: The Adventurer gives the cure to Ishinu's disciples. Ishinu is relieved to hear they will wake up in a few hours.

Name: Subdue the Severe Patient
DescNotCompleted: Ishinu confesses that some disciples have severe symptoms.
DescCompleted: After subduing the frenzied disciples, Beretta begins the treatment. In the process, the two learn about 'Aetherium candy'.

Name: Brewing Must Go On
DescNotCompleted: Beretta wants to destroy all the Aetherium candy to return the brewery to normal.
DescCompleted: The two realize that the ones distributing the Aetherium candy are the Paradise Advent Society.

Name: Another Aetherium Victim
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer heads to the Ancient Tree Shelter with Beretta.
DescCompleted: On their way to the shelter, the Adventurer and Beretta rescue more victims of the Aetherium candy.

Name: Whereabouts of the Paradise Advent Assembly
DescNotCompleted: Beretta asks the people at the shelter to gather information on the Paradise Advent Society.
DescCompleted: The Adventurer learns from the shelter merchants that the Paradise Advent Society members is distributing Aetherium candy and has a secret gathering place.

Name: Strike First for Victory
DescNotCompleted: Beretta heads out to personally greet the Paradise Advent Society members gathering believers nearby.
DescCompleted: Practicing their belief that beating is the best medicine, Beretta and the Adventurer wipe out the Paradise Advent Society members. One of the followers blurts out the hideout's location.

Name: Toward the Hideout
DescNotCompleted: The two uncover the Paradise Advent Society hideout, even resorting to extreme measures.
DescCompleted: Witnessing the atrocities of the Paradise Advent Society, the Adventurer and Beretta eliminate the fanatics and prophets inside.

Name: What I've Been Looking For So Long
DescNotCompleted: Beretta reveals her plan to sabotage the Paradise Advent Society.
DescCompleted: The Adventurer and Beretta search the hideout to find the Scripture of the Paradise Advent Society.

Name: Rescuing the Survivors
DescNotCompleted: They rescue the survivors in the hideout and ensure their safe return.
DescCompleted: Returning to the shelter, the Adventurer hears about Xeros's whereabouts while dropping off the survivors.

Name: How to Reach the Tower
DescNotCompleted: Xeros tells the Adventurer he asked the Liberators of Knowledge about the unidentified device seen at the Ancient Ruins.
DescCompleted: Hekima, a Liberator of Knowledge, hands the Adventurer a transport device and proposes a trade.

Name: Advice for Beginners
DescNotCompleted: Arriving at the tower, the Adventurer begins searching for the Paradise Advent Society.
DescCompleted: The Adventurer asks around about the Paradise Advent Society, but only receives warnings to stay away...

Name: A Speck of Humanity
DescNotCompleted: After escaping the Giant's Tower, the Adventurer meets Beretta.
DescCompleted: The Adventurer and Beretta reunite with the survivors at the Paradise Advent Society's hideout.

Name: Pulsating Hills
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer decides to escort the survivors rescued from the Paradise Advent Society's hideout back to their hometown.
DescCompleted: While heading to “Hesperia” with the survivors, the Adventurer and Beretta witness an arson attack.

Name: Settler Village, Hesperia
DescNotCompleted: The residents of Hesperia endure lives so harsh that they cannot even get timely treatment for their injuries.
DescCompleted: The Adventurer gathers medicinal herbs so Beretta can treat the residents.

Name: Esperança Engolida
DescNotCompleted: Beretta deixa a aldeia, e Remy, guarda da defesa, corre para informar Xavier, representante da aldeia, sobre um assassinato.
PlaceParam: A Ironblood Brigade, um grupo de bandidos que aterroriza os moradores, infiltrou-se nos arredores da aldeia. O Aventureiro decide ajudar os moradores.
DescCompleted: A Ironblood Brigade, um grupo de bandidos que aterroriza os moradores, infiltrou-se nos arredores da aldeia. O Aventureiro decide ajudar os moradores.

Name: Em perseguição à Ironblood Brigade
DescNotCompleted: O Aventureiro persegue a Ironblood Brigade junto com Remy.
PlaceParam: O Aventureiro derrota os membros da Ironblood Brigade que ocupam os principais postos avançados da aldeia e encontra uma pista para solucionar o caso.
DescCompleted: O Aventureiro derrota os membros da Ironblood Brigade que ocupam os principais postos avançados da aldeia e encontra uma pista para solucionar o caso.

Name: Não é para humanos
DescNotCompleted: Xavier insiste que precisam impedir a Ironblood Brigade de caçar pessoas e vendê-las como mercadoria.
PlaceParam: Após resgatar os moradores capturados, o Aventureiro presencia as atrocidades da Ironblood Brigade.
DescCompleted: Após resgatar os moradores capturados, o Aventureiro presencia as atrocidades da Ironblood Brigade.

Name: Não há tempo para se culpar
DescNotCompleted: O Aventureiro e Xavier procuram a Hesperia Reconnaissance Squad, posicionada ao redor de Hallowed Obsidian Mountain.
PlaceParam: A Hesperia Reconnaissance Squad traz notícias inesperadas sobre a Kiguru Tribe.
DescCompleted: A Hesperia Reconnaissance Squad traz notícias inesperadas sobre a Kiguru Tribe.

Name: A investida da Kiguru Tribe
DescNotCompleted: A Kiguru Tribe começa a avançar contra a unidade de reconhecimento.
PlaceParam: O Aventureiro une forças com a Hesperia Reconnaissance Squad para deter o avanço da Kiguru Tribe antes que ela cause ainda mais danos.
DescCompleted: O Aventureiro une forças com a Hesperia Reconnaissance Squad para deter o avanço da Kiguru Tribe antes que ela cause ainda mais danos.

Name: Recuperando os suprimentos
DescNotCompleted: Xavier pede ajuda para recuperar os suprimentos roubados pela Kiguru Tribe.
PlaceParam: O Aventureiro e a batedora Alayn recuperam da Kiguru Tribe os últimos suprimentos da unidade, garantindo o futuro do posto avançado.
DescCompleted: O Aventureiro e a batedora Alayn recuperam da Kiguru Tribe os últimos suprimentos da unidade, garantindo o futuro do posto avançado.

Name: Rumores de bastidores são sempre sujos
DescNotCompleted: Alayn pede ao Aventureiro que organize os suprimentos.
PlaceParam: Após concluir o trabalho no posto avançado, o Aventureiro segue com Xavier para Frantia Gate, atrás da Ironblood Brigade.
DescCompleted: Após concluir o trabalho no posto avançado, o Aventureiro segue com Xavier para Frantia Gate, atrás da Ironblood Brigade.

Name: Não atravesse aquela ponte
DescNotCompleted: O Aventureiro tenta entrar em contato com Xeros, mas não consegue alcançá-lo.
PlaceParam: Alayn arrisca uma estratégia ousada e se alia ao Aventureiro para impedir Xavier de agir por conta própria.
DescCompleted: Alayn arrisca uma estratégia ousada e se alia ao Aventureiro para impedir Xavier de agir por conta própria.

Name: A autoridade traz responsabilidade
DescNotCompleted: Apesar das tentativas de Alayn para detê-lo, Xavier insiste em perseguir a Ironblood Brigade até o fim.
PlaceParam: O Aventureiro e Xavier encontram Didier, da guarda de Frantia Gate, que se mostra extremamente pouco cooperativo...
DescCompleted: O Aventureiro e Xavier encontram Didier, da guarda de Frantia Gate, que se mostra extremamente pouco cooperativo...

Name: With Great Tolerance
DescNotCompleted: Xavier endures humiliation for the sake of Hesperia.
DescCompleted: Didier works Xavier and the Adventurer to the bone, promising an audience with his superior in exchange for their help.

Name: A Good Night's Sleep is Paramount
DescNotCompleted: Didier keeps dumping monster-hunting tasks on the Adventurer under the guise of arranging a meeting with the Guard Captain.
DescCompleted: After constantly stalling for time, Didier marvels at the Adventurer's skills.

Name: Frantia Gate Guard
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer and Xavier enter the Frantia Gate under Didier's guidance.
DescCompleted: Unlike the desperate and dire situation in Hesperia, the Frantia Gate seems quite prosperous despite being positioned beyond the border...

Name: Only Following Orders
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer and Xavier meet Gate Guard Captain “Leonard.”
DescCompleted: Contrary to expectations, the Frantia Guards maintain strict silence regarding the Ironblood Brigade.

Name: Paying Back in Kind
DescNotCompleted: Reunited with Alayn, the Adventurer decides to eliminate the Ironblood Brigade.
DescCompleted: While heading north with the scouts and setting up tents and traps, the Adventurer encounters an intruder.

Name: Knight and Commoner
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer and the scouts move out to uncover the identity of the voice.
DescCompleted: The Adventurer and the scouts meet the owner of the voice. “Lena,” Commander of the Knights of the Frostwind, is deeply ashamed, stating that the Gate Guards have forsaken chivalry.

Name: Knights of the Frostwind
DescNotCompleted: Lena explains the infiltration operation to the Adventurer.
DescCompleted: Before deploying the Adventurer to the operation area, Lena requests a spar to test their skills.

Name: Solid Verification
DescNotCompleted: Having verified the Adventurer's skills, Lena assigns them a mission.
DescCompleted: Completing the mission, the Adventurer receives an Aether Detonator from Lena and plants it.

Name: Charge!
DescNotCompleted: The Knights of the Frostwind advance on the Ironblood Brigade.
DescCompleted: The Adventurer and the Knights of the Frostwind begin to wipe out the Ironblood Brigade.

Name: Drive Them Into a Corner!
DescNotCompleted: Pushing inward from the outskirts, the Adventurer moves toward the center alongside Lena.
DescCompleted: The Adventurer defeats the Commander of the Ironblood Brigade. The Knights of the Frostwind escort the wounded and escape the castle.

Name: After Executing Justice
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer and the knights retreat, due to the sudden appearance of the Kiguru Tribe.
DescCompleted: The Adventurer helps treat the injured knights, and Lena promises to deliver news of the Adventurer to Hesperia.

Name: Anomaly on the Hallowed Obsidian Mountain
DescNotCompleted: While climbing the Hallowed Obsidian Mountain, the Adventurer discovers Kiguru tribe members exhibiting symptoms of Etherium poisoning.
DescCompleted: Concerned about the Aetherium poisoning, the Adventurer defeats the Kiguru Tribe to ensure safety.

Name: Aetherium and the Mage
DescNotCompleted: Arriving deep within the Holy Mountain, the Adventurer encounters unexpected figures.
DescCompleted: Xeros stops the mysterious mage. The Adventurer states their intention to find the Captain first.

Name: Performance Check
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer promises to reunite with Xeros at the Starfall Plateau.
DescCompleted: Calling the Adventurer to the “Rappie Training Ground” to check their condition, Beretta criticizes them for always returning battered.

Name: Rappie Training Ground
DescNotCompleted: They try to rest at the Rappie Training Ground to check if they are fully recovered, but Camp Keeper “Sarabi” stops them.
DescCompleted: Beretta feels relieved that the test results for both the Adventurer and the Rappie are positive.

Name: A Place of No Return
DescNotCompleted: Beretta suggests gathering information about the plateau from the mercenaries at the training camp.
DescCompleted: The Adventurer and Beretta explain the situation to the Frantia Consul “Lorraine,” whom they encounter by chance, and receive an official letter requesting cooperation.

Name: To the Stormkel Official Residence
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer seeks out the Stormkel Legation in Babylon, carrying Lorraine's personal letter.
DescCompleted: You put Beretta's request on hold to visit the Stormkel Legation, but the atmosphere is tense. It might be best to return later.

Name: A New Clue
DescNotCompleted: Having returned to Babylon, the Adventurer meets Ragnar to find clues.
DescCompleted: Ragnar helps the Adventurer meet Eric, the lieutenant of the Stormkel Legation.

Name: A Small Clue
DescNotCompleted: Eric shares a report of a Paradise Advent Society follower sighted at the “Verzard Outpost.”
DescCompleted: With Eric's recommendation letter, the Adventurer heads to the Verzard Outpost to meet Commander “Marten.”

Name: Verzard Outpost
DescNotCompleted: Using the Paradise Advent Society investigation as an excuse, Marten asks the Adventurer to train the new recruits.
DescCompleted: While slaying monsters at the snowfield entrance during recruit training, the Adventurer encounters a stranded recruit and uncovers a clue about the Paradise Advent Society followers.

Name: Cold Northerner
DescNotCompleted: After informing Commander Marten of the lack of progress, the Adventurer is told to investigate the Geyser Field.
DescCompleted: While gathering weapon materials for the recruit test in the Geyser Field, the Adventurer discovers a Tesseract fragment.

Name: Only the Strong Survive
DescNotCompleted: Hearing that an Incursion occurs during every recruit training session, the Adventurer sets out to deploy armaments to ensure safety in the surrounding area.
DescCompleted: The Adventurer finds a deserter, but they have no intention of returning to the outpost.

Name: The Path Forward
DescNotCompleted: The deserter tells the Adventurer they wish to join Astrid's forces rather than return to the outpost.
DescCompleted: At the deserter's request, the Adventurer visits Schulmann at the Naruru Hot Springs. They ask about the Paradise Advent Society, but fail to find solid clues.

Name: Suspicion Is No Good
DescNotCompleted: Outpost Detachment Commander Karl hands over a duty log, suspecting that the Paradise Advent Society and Astrid have joined forces.
DescCompleted: The Adventurer approaches Astrid's Citadel with an outpost soldier. As the soldier draws near, Astrid's forces suddenly attack.

Name: Careful Judgment
DescNotCompleted: Karl asks the Adventurer to investigate what is happening at Astrid's Citadel.
DescCompleted: The Adventurer catches the Paradise Advent Prophet secretly colluding with Astrid's soldiers at the citadel.

Name: God of War
DescNotCompleted: Ragnar visits the outpost following the incident at Astrid's Citadel.
DescCompleted: Exploring the citadel with Ragnar, the Adventurer learns of his shared past with Astrid.

Name: Judgment
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer and Ragnar strike down Astrid's followers who allied with the Paradise Advent Society.
DescCompleted: Soldiers fight to crown Astrid as High Chieftain. Reunited with Ragnar, the Adventurer waits for her arrival.

Name: The Point of No Return
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer and Ragnar confront Astrid, the so-called God of War.
DescCompleted: Leaving the fight with Astrid to Ragnar, the Adventurer tracks the Paradise Advent Society to the Vagrant's Repose.

Name: Encounter
DescNotCompleted: Reunited with Xeros, the Adventurer begins searching the Repose for clues about the Paradise Advent Society.
DescCompleted: The Adventurer learns that the Paradise Advent Society has visited the Repose. Xeros shows he has found the Grandmaster's Shield.

Name: Vagrant's Repose
DescNotCompleted: While Xeros tracks the Grandmaster's trail, the Adventurer seeks information from Helena, the Repose's caretaker.
DescCompleted: The Adventurer defeats monsters at the Sere-Moss Heights to earn Helena's trust.

Name: Beyond Our Control
DescNotCompleted:
The Adventurer helps Helena, slowly lowering her guard.
She asks for help gathering medicinal herbs for the sick.
DescCompleted: While gathering herbs, the Adventurer finds a journal with familiar handwriting. Upon their return, Helena declares she cannot betray the Paradise Advent Society.

Name: Nevertheless
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer confronts Xeros among the Aetherium addicts.
DescCompleted: The Adventurer clashes with Xeros over his treatment of the addicts, only realizing back at the Repose that all of this happened because of Helena.

Name: The Promise of the Survivors
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer helps Helena finally fulfill her duties as the Repose's master.
DescCompleted: While sorting through keepsakes, the Adventurer is asked by Helena to deliver a locket to Vahista at the “Bardad Expedition Encampment.”

Name: Living for Today
DescNotCompleted: Reunited with Vahista, the Adventurer hands over Gilbert's locket.
DescCompleted: The Adventurer gathers ingredients so Vahista can prepare a meal in Gilbert's memory.

Name: Our Promise
DescNotCompleted: Vahista, who still needs time to process her feelings, relies on the Adventurer to mourn her loss.
DescCompleted: The Adventurer discovers keepsakes left by Gilbert in the ruins.

Name: For Tomorrow
DescNotCompleted: Carrying the dish filled with Vahista and Gilbert's wishes, the Adventurer sets off for Stormkel Gate.
DescCompleted: On the way to the gate, the Adventurer encounters Administrator “Gale,” who is troubled by the Paradise Advent Society.

Name: Manpower Shortages are Inevitable
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer helps Gale investigate the abnormal Incursions occurring without precursor events.
DescCompleted: Using a permit as bait, Gale begs the Adventurer for one more favor.

Name: A Conscience Barely Kept
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer discovers the Paradise Advent Society is responsible for the abnormal Incursions.
DescCompleted: Carying Gale's report and a temporary permit, the Adventurer heads to Stormkel Gate.

Name: For Revenge
DescNotCompleted: Stormkel Gatekeeper “Gerda” requests the Adventurer to subjugate the Paradise Advent Society.
DescCompleted: The Adventurer realizes the Paradise Advent Society is being used as a smokescreen for Astrid's rebellion.

Name: What Must Be Done
DescNotCompleted: As a reward for the request, the Adventurer gathers ingredients to feed the people of the Repose.
DescCompleted: The supply depot administrator promises to deliver the food made from Vahista's recipe to the Repose.

Name: Reason to Believe
DescNotCompleted: En route to meet Xeros, the Adventurer encounters a girl who used to be a Paradise Advent Society follower.
DescCompleted: She asks the Adventurer to leave a token at the Paradise Advent Society's sanctuary and to tell her if a true paradise exists should they meet again.

Name: The Permitted
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer decides to join forces with Xeros and eradicate the Paradise Advent Society.
DescCompleted: The duo performs a special ritual instructed by Xeros to enter the sanctuary.

Name: The Sanctuary
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer heads to the sanctuary with Xeros.
DescCompleted: After defeating the Paradise Advent Society followers around the sanctuary, the two split up to find Ingel.

Name: Diverging Paths
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer confronts Ingel alongside Xeros.
DescCompleted: The Adventurer learns the full truth. Before the shock subsides, Xeros declares he will eliminate Ingel and destroy the Tower.

Name: Fate
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer reunites with the unknown entity.
DescCompleted: The Adventurer informs the Divines of the situation and begs for their aid to prevent the Tower's collapse.

Name: The Last Stand Under the Knowledge
DescNotCompleted: A brutal battle leaves the Adventurer's Aether system shattered. Yet, ignoring all injuries, the Adventurer is determined to find a way to reach the Warden of the Tower. Worrying about the wounded hero's condition, the Divines insist on unconditional rest, taking it upon themselves to handle the matter.
DescCompleted: Despite everyone’s plead to take a rest and recover, the Adventurer presses on to meet the Warden, only to learn through Hekima that the Tower depths are inaccessible. To find another way through, Koon suggests heading to his hometown, the Twisted Elysium, to track down an old friend who might have the answers.

Name: Hunter's Territory
DescNotCompleted: The journey took the Adventurer through the ancient pass known as the Dragon's Breath, leading straight to the hunters' temporary base—but something feels entirely off. Supplies lie scattered everywhere, and the veteran hunters who should be guarding the perimeter are nowhere to be found.
DescCompleted: The outpost stands completely neglected, a blunder Koon deems as serious offense—more than enough to get someone expelled from the guild. They rummage through the abandoned supply sacks looking for the name of the person in charge, but the search only breeds deeper suspicion: either the hunters fled in a sheer panic, or they were dragged into something sinister.

Name: A Helping Hand I
DescNotCompleted: With the whereabouts of the hunters who headed south still unknown, a lone rookie named Paran steps up to pack the remaining provisions and lead the way.
DescCompleted: The Adventurer meets Paran in the empty outpost, who has been trying to help the townsfolk even though it was not her responsibility. Guided by this kind-hearted newcomer, the party finally meets Ranon, a veteran hunter stationed nearby.

Name: A Helping Hand II
DescNotCompleted: Paran is an unfamiliar face even to Koon. Shy to a fault and hardly giving off the impression of a seasoned hunter, this newcomer seems a bit out of place.
DescCompleted: Yet, Paran successfully guides the party to Ranon. However, the veteran hunter makes one thing clear: to get any information on the friend Koon is looking for, the party must first prove their worth out in the field.

Name: An Unfair Match
DescNotCompleted: To ask anything of a hunter, you must display your mastery over the art of hunting—even when you are a legendary figures revered as a Divine.
DescCompleted: It seems hunters only speak the language of the hunt. Neither Koon nor Ranon find it the least bit strange that they are suddenly jumping into a hunting competition out of the blue.

Name: A Rookie Hunter in Peril
DescNotCompleted: Ranon and Koon make a wager on who hunts better—only to be cut short by a faint scream echoing from the depths of the hunting grounds.
DescCompleted: Drawn into the wager after taunts from the two hunters, the Adventurer competes to track down monsters until Paran’s frantic voice suddenly cuts through the air. The Adventurer rushes deep into the area to save her.

Name: Gold Is But a Raging Prey I
DescNotCompleted: Paran, a descendant of the fallen kingdom, diligently gathers supplies to support those sharing her tragic plight.
DescCompleted: After rescuing Paran from danger, the Adventurer rejoins Koon to talk about the outcome of the hunting wager. Word arrives from Beretta while the party waits for Ranon, revealing a new lead on how to reach the Tower depths.

Name: Gold Is But a Raging Prey II
DescNotCompleted: Although the Adventurer emerges victorious in the match against Ranon, the veteran hunter talks big about the true essence of the hunt, pushing for yet another wager.
DescCompleted: It seems a hunter's vocabulary consists of nothing but the word "hunt." This guy rummages through monster carcasses for hours, yet remains completely unfazed...!

Name: Gold Is But a Raging Prey III
DescNotCompleted: This hunting match is dragging on too long and needs to end. After all, Rada and Beretta were very clear that this trip was supposed to be a peaceful getaway.
DescCompleted: A hunter’s dictionary definitely has only two words: "hunt" and "competition." Perhaps the Hunters Guild’s regular tournaments were always the ultimate proof of their stubborn nature.

Name: To Lure the Tracker
DescNotCompleted: How did a match between Koon and Ranon somehow warp into a contest between the Adventurer and Ranon? For someone who neither belongs to the Hunters Guild nor hunts for trophies, both sides seem to be taking this far too seriously.
DescCompleted: Accepting Ranon’s taunt, the Adventurer enters into a new wager to bring back intact monster carcasses. Under Koon’s strict judging, Ranon finally accepts defeat and reveals information about Auren.

Name: The Most Valuable Treasure I
DescNotCompleted: According to Ranon, Auren is over at the Hunter's Village. Arriving at the village with Koon, the Adventurer discovers a crying young boy.
DescCompleted: To help the kid, Mucha, the party decides to look for the sister he is waiting for. Remembering what Mucha said about his sister's Rappie, Paran comes up with a simple plan.

Name: The Most Valuable Treasure II
DescNotCompleted: Rappies are known to love hay. Since Auren’s Rappie has a huge appetite, using hay as bait is the perfect way to lure it out.
DescCompleted: As the scent of hay brings the creature bolting out, a startled Auren appears right before the Adventurer.

Name: The Treasure Hunter's Quest
DescNotCompleted: Auren is searching for a treasure that sounds like something straight out of an old legend or a fairy tale.
DescCompleted: Auren was away for so long because she was playing a game of treasure hunt with Mucha. Hoping to find a fitting gift for the child, Auren plans to put up markers in the remaining areas before heading back.

Name: In Search of the Horn I
DescNotCompleted: What kind of rare curiosities does a proud treasure hunter like Auren usually seek out?
DescCompleted: Surprisingly, Mucha seems to know far more about obscure folklore than the expert herself. Paran mentions having heard of a unique artifact called the "Horn of Dawn" from the child before.

Name: Someone’s Dreamkeeper
DescNotCompleted: Following Auren’s advice, the Adventurer and Paran head out to look for the Dragon Hunter.
DescCompleted: While scaling the cliffside, Paran undergoes a sudden crisis caused by a mysterious pain, which leads to an unexpected encounter with the dragon hunter Karam, who has been watching them. When the party reveals their goal of searching for dragon signs, Karam scoffs and demands they prove their worth first.

Name: The Heat of Battle
DescNotCompleted: The "Horn of Dawn" rumored to be taken by a dragon might be nothing more than a toy from an old folk tale. Yet, the journey leads straight into the dragon's lair.
DescCompleted: The search through the dragon's lair alongside Karam yields no trace of any genuine artifacts, nor any creature resembling a dragon.

Name: In Search of the Horn II
DescNotCompleted: Mentioning rumors that the surrounding hunting grounds were also part of the dragon's territory, Karam suggests heading to a new location.
DescCompleted: While the search resumes in this new area, Koon rejoins the party after finishing his business back in the village. He tells the others that Auren advised them to seek out the Bardad Expedition next.

Name: To the Bardad Expedition Forward Waypoint
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer and Koon leave the heart of the Elysium, moving east toward the Bardad Expedition base.
DescCompleted: Along the way, the party spots several strange figures acting erratically. After scouting ahead, Koon returns with a grim report: these lost souls are aggressive, restless undead.

Name: Those Who Couldn’t Return
DescNotCompleted: Koon cannot hide his shock, noting that such horrors have never plagued the Elysium before.
DescCompleted: Sensing that this ominous corruption is creeping westward, the party decides to follow the dark energy to uncover the truth behind this sudden malice.

Name: Forbidden Altar
DescNotCompleted: Deep within a sunless forest, Koon feels a strange, ominous energy crawling through his homeland and grows deeply uneasy.
DescCompleted: Wandering undead creatures plague the woods. While investigating these signs—which seem to defy the teachings of the Kingdom of Tan—Koon and the Adventurer discover an untouched altar.

Name: Raven’s Wish
DescNotCompleted: As the party approaches to inspect the untouched altar, the undead ambush them as if the had been waiting for that exact moment.
DescCompleted: After striking down the monsters, Koon reports the incident to Babylon. Suddenly, a trembling voice echoes from nearby. The party sees a terrified man, who says he could not bring himself to swing a weapon against an undead with his neighbor's face.

Name: A Trail of Suspicions
DescNotCompleted: The adventurer escorts the survivor back to the encampment Koon mentioned earlier. The moment the rescued man sees Koon, relief washes over his face.
DescCompleted: Nuul presents a grand speech about ancient bloodlines and a great destiny. Koon flatly rejects Nuul’s offer and delivers a stern warning. Yet, Nuul refuses to abandon his obsession with restoring the fallen Kingdom of Tan, declaring that the necessary artifacts are already prepared.

Name: Amidst the Dirt and Dust
DescNotCompleted: After striking down the undead that raided the encampment, the Adventurer sets off alone to the Bardad Expedition, leaving Koon behind to investigate the details of the attack.
DescCompleted: Putting the undead crisis aside for a moment, the Adventurer arrives at the Bardad Expedition to find a way to approach the Tower depths once again. Chedar, the officer in charge, promises to look for records that might serve as a clue, but demands a few favors in return.

Name: Horn of Dawn
DescNotCompleted: Chedar brings out an old expedition journal, which seems to contain information regarding the artifact called 'Horn of Dawn.'
DescCompleted: At Chedar's suggestion, the Adventurer travels to seek out the Cave Owls, who are well-versed in the lore of the Horn of Dawn. Heading south along the path, the Adventurer runs into another expedition member, Vedat.

Name: Experiments
DescNotCompleted: Chedar agrees to assist with Vedat's pressing experiments. The 'Lake of Spirits'—a spot frequently visited by the Cave Owls—is chosen as the testing ground.
DescCompleted: While investigating anomalies around the area alongside Chedar, the Adventurer encounters a fleeing survivor who warns of a monstrous figure at the lake. This ruthless rogue, who strikes down innocent people without mercy, must be stopped.

Name: Hound of the Paradise
DescNotCompleted: Vaster, the savage figure terrorizing the weak, exudes a fierce, transcendent energy reminiscent of Valbas, the mage encountered back at the Hallowed Obsidian Mountain.
DescCompleted: This relentless menace continues to rampage across the sacred ritual grounds of the Cave Owls. The Adventurer stands firm and engages in a fierce duel against Vaster, when Valbas suddenly appears and reveals an unexpected truth.

Name: Purpose of the Key
DescNotCompleted: Following the clash at the Lake of Spirits, Chedar passes along word that a mysterious visitor has arrived, asking about the Adventurer’s whereabouts.
DescCompleted: Near the levistone buried beneath the Bardad Expedition, the Adventurer activates the 'Key,' an artifact previously received from Beretta, and confronts the Warden of the Tower. The Warden explains that the 'Core' was sent outside and must be recovered to protect the Tower from Xeros.

Name: The Swiftest Messenger
DescNotCompleted: Following the conversation with the Warden, an inexplicable condition begins to plague the Adventurer's body. Yet, the collapse of the Tower must be pervented and there is no time to delay.
DescCompleted: To recover from these strange symptoms, the Adventurer stays with Koon to rest and regain strength near the Lake of Spirits. After bidding farewell to the short-handed Chedar, the party sets out to seek out Koon’s messenger hawk to send an urgent plea for aid to Babylon.

Name: Well-Fed Wings
DescNotCompleted: Koon's messenger hawk, Thunderwings, obeys the Archon of Frantia better than Koon himself. To win the bird over, the party must prepare a special treat.
DescCompleted: With the special meal ready, the party heads to a high hill. Just as the food is prepared and the hawk is ready for flight, the party faces the aggressive undead pack from days ago.

Name: Unbound Wraiths
DescNotCompleted: Mysterious altars are discovered throughout various parts of the Elysium, bringing a heavy shadow of death across the region. Koon senses that this is no mere coincidence.
DescCompleted: Postponing their original mission to recover the Core for a moment, Koon suggests heading into the Red Mist Forest to uncover the dark truth behind these altars.

Name: Orica’s Request
DescNotCompleted: Orica, Master of the Explorers Guild, asks the Adventurer to brew Ninkar and go to the Giant’s Tower.

Name: Fresh Ingredients I
DescNotCompleted: Orica helps the Adventurer collect the first ingredient, a Monster’s Heart. Guided by Orica, the Adventurer explores the Lower floor.

Name: Fresh Ingredients II
DescNotCompleted: Guided by Orica, the Adventurer moves to the Middle floor to collect the second ingredient. Strange noises keep coming from the communicator...

Name: A Clean Give-and-Take
DescNotCompleted: The voice from the communicator belonged to Elin. Elin decides to help the Adventurer in return for being rescued.

Name: Queen's Explorer
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer succeeds in crafting a Ninkar with Elin’s help. Upon returning to Babylon, the Adventurer hears a shocking story from Orica...

Name: Know When to Stop Calling
DescNotCompleted: Called by Orica, the Adventurer visits the Explorers Guild. After checking an anonymous letter and an Image Recorder, they head to Tower 2F.

Name: Truth or Lies
DescNotCompleted: After arriving on the second floor, the Adventurer finds the Image Recording Device with Weifel’s help.

Name: Power Decides All
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer meets a Queen’s Investigator named ‘Shila’. Shila reveals the secrets surrounding the tower to the Adventurer.

Name: A Label
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer takes on Shila’s trial. Orica entrusts the investigation of the Queen’s Investigator to the Adventurer.

Name: Let’s Not Get Involved
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer meets Bailey at the Ancient Imperial Institute Ruins. She proposes a perilous commission and suggests heading to Tower 3F.

Name: Shattered Trust
DescNotCompleted: Arriving on the tower’s third floor, the Adventurer tries to hide the ancient objects for safety.

Name: Fists Are Everything
DescNotCompleted: Guided by Ozkan, the Adventurer encounters the Queen’s Investigator. While checking on her condition, a sudden memory flows into them.

Name: Chain of Command
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer agrees to accept Jeda’s bet with the condition of returning the member of the Spring-Water Raven Academic Society to the Forsaken Land.

Name: Sender Unknown
DescNotCompleted: At Muina’s request, the Adventurer meets Nasser.

Name: The Expendable
DescNotCompleted: Nasser orders the Adventurer to find the secret letter of the Shadow Wolf Clan.

Name: Wolf Hunt
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer is shocked after reading the secret letter of the Shadow Wolf Clan.

Name: A Different Side
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer goes to Muina with Nasser to receive the commission fee, only to witness another side of her.

Name: A Dangerous Trade
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer receives an offer from Muina he can’t refuse.

Name: Archon’s Banter
DescNotCompleted: “Lorraine”, Frantia’s Archon, sends you on an errand after complimenting you for stopping the Paradise Advent Society.

Name: It’s All About Customer Satisfaction
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer moves to Taima Pioneer Village with Beretta. They end up purchasing all the new ‘Taima Liquor’ from the spirits merchant...

Name: Doesn’t Take a Long Tail To Get Caught
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer decides to give the confused Beretta some time to gather herself after reuniting with a friend that ran away.

Name: Escape from the Paradise
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer hears about the childhood of the two. Beretta chooses to move forward instead of drowning in sentiment.

Name: “Shiny Head” Naruru
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer meets Beretta’s ‘helper.’ Refusing to acknowledge the Adventurer so easily, the helper presents a riddle.

Name: Awesome Potion
DescNotCompleted: “Schulak”, the benefactor, wants to see if the Adventurer is a good fit for their alliance and gives a new riddle.

Name: Alcohol Needed for the Greater Good
DescNotCompleted: After arriving at the brewery, Baretta rushes the Adventurer to stop Xeros.

Name: Entangled
DescNotCompleted: Beretta and the Adventurer move to the Pulsing Ridge to investigate likely locations. They examine Aether clusters that have strangely gathered in one spot.

Name: What The Ruined Nation Left Behind
DescNotCompleted: After moving north to investigate the last entangled Aether, the two have an unexpected encounter.

Name: The White Lion Hunts The Wolf
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer encounters an unexpected person at the site where the Ironblood Brigade was wiped out. What is the reason they are waiting so solemnly at the Hill of Lament?

Name: Spreading the Bait Vast and Serene
DescNotCompleted: “Quaista”, the Avenger, suggests letting the Shadow Wolf Clan carry out their plans instead of taking care of them right away.

Name: The Fool and the Idiot
DescNotCompleted: The remnants of the Shadow Wolves attempt to realize their grand dreams as they see fit. They seem completely unaware of the danger they are in.

Name: A Child Has to Grow Up Strong
DescNotCompleted: Fear is non-existent for the little one living in the settler village of Hesperia. Let’s help them grow into a just and strong adult.

Name: The End of the Masquerade
DescNotCompleted: Members of the Wolf Clan, who travelled from the Giant’s Garden to the Pulsing Ridge, are finally on the move. It is time to begin the operation.

Name: All in a Single Bite
DescNotCompleted: Quietly hunting down the wolves, the Adventurer moves to the entrance of the Starfall Plateau. Soon, someone who dispatches ‘prey’ in one bite appears...

Name: A Prey Too Good to Lose
DescNotCompleted: The avenger, Ramin, appears as someone broken. Should we stop him as he ruins the operation to go back and hunt along the path we came?

Name: If There Aren’t Any Witnesses
DescNotCompleted: The avengers gather in one place to establish their next operation. They hold their breath, waiting to snatch their second prey.

Name: The Snake’s Tail
DescNotCompleted: The head of the Yellow Snake family is one of the main culprits who pushed the avengers to ruin. Let’s prevent them from moving their forces.

Name: A Coded Promise
DescNotCompleted: Contacted by Aman, the Adventurer receives a document containing a code familiar to the Sverd Mercenaries. Upon visiting the location mentioned, they find a familiar object.

Name: Unspoken Words
DescNotCompleted: Checking the contents of the Image Recorder with Beretta’s help, the Adventurer discovers Simon’s tracks, which they might have otherwise never known.

Name: A Secret Revealed
DescNotCompleted: Through the visual record device, the adventurer learns the truth behind the disbandment of the Sverd Mercenaries.

Name: Tailing the Target
DescNotCompleted: Reviewing the Image Recorder with Beretta, the Adventurer finally gains a faint understanding of why the mercenary group was formed.

Name: The Snowfield Mage
DescNotCompleted: Ragnar asks the Adventurer to visit the Verzard Outpost. The reason being that the Mage of the Snowfield active on the plateau seems to be from the mercenary group.

Name: The Hidden Path
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer moves to Stormkel Gate. They meet the Mage of the Snowfield at the Crossroads Shelter.

Name: At the Crossroads
DescNotCompleted: Nova, who already knew of Libi’s situation, reviews the Image Recorder with the Adventurer. The Adventurer confirms once again that Yngel is the mastermind behind this.

Name: For You Are the Spear and the Sword
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer encounters Beretta at the Paradise Advent Society Sanctuary. Despite the death of their leader, Yngel, the society remains fully intact.

Name: Unwavering Resolve
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer investigates the Paradise Advent Society Sanctuary in search of Libi’s traces. After much effort, they find Libi’s belongings and leave the sanctuary with Beretta.

Name: Determine Your Own Purpose
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer and Nova help Helena, the mistress of the shelter, to craft emergency medicine. They also pay their respects to Libi.

Name: Just Pass By
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer hears a strange voice from the communicator. It belongs to an ancient artifact sitting next to a very exhausted-looking man.

Name: Indifferent Hope
DescNotCompleted: Zisen asks the Adventurer for help. He requests that they find a recording disc in the Ethereal Sanctum.

Name: I Hate Being in Debt
DescNotCompleted: The adventurer heads back to the Ethereal Sanctum once more at Weifel’s request.

Name: I Can’t Stand Being in Debt
DescNotCompleted: While Zisen analyzes the recording disc, the Adventurer collects materials for Weifel’s repairs. They also learn about the creator of the Ethereal Sanctum...

Name: Constant Procrastination
DescNotCompleted: At Weifel’s request, the adventurer rescues Zisen once again.

Name: Say I Can’t, and I’ll Do it
DescNotCompleted: At Zisen’s request, the adventurer investigates the Ironblood Brigade alongside Weifel.

Name: Even Better if it’s Forbidden
DescNotCompleted: The adventurer uncovers the details about the secret experiments being conducted by the Ironblood Brigade.

Name: Always Someone One Step Ahead
DescNotCompleted: Having learned how to operate Weifel from Zisen, the adventurer begins gathering evidence in earnest.

Name: Somehow Has to Clean Up the Mess
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer delivers the evidence found in Kiguruikish to Zisen. Zisen mentions that he will meet with another Liberator.

Name: What Is Being Liberated?
DescNotCompleted: Faced again with Hekima, the Liberator of Knowledge. It is time to pay the price for the ‘Phase Converter’ received from him.

Name: Scars of the Regressor
DescNotCompleted: Could the peculiar reaction of the Monolith be due to the Adventurer’s influence? The Liberator suggests recovering the remnants.

Name: Revolution Never Comes
DescNotCompleted: The Paradise Advent Society followers still roam the area. There is no longer a shelter for them to return to.

Name: A Matter of Privilege
DescNotCompleted: The path for the great cause is not purely clean. There are always those who criticize heroes everywhere.

Name: Imitations Can Never Surpass the Original
DescNotCompleted: Various factions in the Forsaken Land are interested in the ‘artifacts.’ At Monas’s suggestion, the Adventurer heads to the Appraisers Guild.

Name: For Whom is Knowledge Intended?
DescNotCompleted: The Appraisers’ Guild reveals unexpected information, as if hiding a storm beneath their calm exterior.

Name: A Second Visit
DescNotCompleted: Stepping into the unknown once more, the adventurer feels as though a mysterious power is guiding them.

Name: Secrets Meant to be Hidden
DescNotCompleted: Traveling to the ruins with the Liberators, the adventurer finds the face of the interloper blocking the entrance looking strangely familiar...

Name: A Worthless Rock
DescNotCompleted: The adventurer unleashes power toward an ordinary rock and witnesses a wondrous phenomenon.

Name: Academic Value
DescNotCompleted: While the liberators are away, the adventurer decides to search the area for more clues.

Name: What the Divine Left Behind
DescNotCompleted: An unexpected item is found among Beretta’s discarded belongings at the Bardad Expedition Garrison.

Name: A Favor Requires a Reward First
DescNotCompleted: As the adventurer encounters Rada in front of the Divines’ Waypoint, she explains her purpose for being there.

Name: An Unsettling Silence
DescNotCompleted: Examining the item Beretta discarded with Rada, the adventurer uncovers a certain historical truth...

Name: Closer Requires Caution
DescNotCompleted: Uncharacteristically, Rada hesitates to ask for help to achieve her goal. What could be the reason?

Name: White, Colorful, and Bumpy
DescNotCompleted: Rada falls into thought again after recovering the lost item. It’s true that it needs analysis, but she seems worried her friend might get angry...

Name: A Twisted Conclusion
DescNotCompleted: The situation changes rapidly due to the unplanned intrusion of the Liberators of Knowledge. The Adventurer once again faces traces of the ancients.

Name: Old Mouth, Old Story
DescNotCompleted: We need to conduct an inquiry, but the investigator is shy. Even so, if it’s something that must be done...

Name: The Rumor That Dragons Love Treasure
DescNotCompleted: Finding yourself in a situation that has become quite familiar, you decided to help with a troublesome task. Rumors about transcendent beings usually start with places that ad plausibility to the rumors.

Name: Star Forest
DescNotCompleted: Fairytale books stimulate children’s imagination, but the amnesiac Naie seeks to uncover a certain truth within them.

Name: The Boundary Between Dreams and Fairytales
DescNotCompleted: Losing consciousness is a very rare experience, but Naie moves according to the ‘countermeasures’ as if she is used to it.

Name: The Power Required for the Body
DescNotCompleted: Unable to erase the thought that priorities have changed, you head to the Paradise Advent Society’s hideout with Sekien, who calmly tells you to follow him.

Name: Unforgettable Things
DescNotCompleted: Sekien shows an aloof attitude even with a sick comrade, but sometimes reveals heightened emotions. What could be the reason?

Name: Uninterpreted Information
DescNotCompleted: Regaining consciousness, Naie tries to move towards the goal again without a moment to catch her breath. However, fairytales, legends, and myths might actually just be word of mouth.

Name: Blank Memory
DescNotCompleted: As a result of investigating with Naie, it is concluded that a massive truth can be faced through the bracelet she has been wearing all along.

Name: Insufficient Drinking Water
DescNotCompleted: The detachment soldier ‘Bahar’ asks the Adventurer to clear the area so that drinking water can be brought in safely.

Name: Loot Collector
DescNotCompleted: ‘Leyla’, the merchant trading monster loots, proposes a task to the Adventurer.

Name: Luring Trap
DescNotCompleted: ‘Iruna’, a hunter who wants Khoon’s approval, asks to bring back materials to make traps.

Name: One-sided Partner
DescNotCompleted: Impressed by the Adventurer’s skill, Leyla proposes a partnership and offers another task.

Name: Cleaning Up The Northern Road
DescNotCompleted: Jeihan asks to clean up the road to the Valley of Beasts.

Name: Scholar’s Duty
DescNotCompleted: Helene, who is in a rush to submit her thesis, asks the Adventurer to defeat the monsters near the ruins.

Name: Historic Discovery
DescNotCompleted: Helene asks the Adventurer to bring her the relic fragments from the Giant’s Corridor.

Name: Cleaning Up The Eastern Road
DescNotCompleted: Jeihan asks the Adventurer to clean up the monsters in Gorge of Perdition that have multiplied after migrating North.

Name: Red Signal Flare
DescNotCompleted: ‘Kanber’, the dispatch from the Wayfinders Guild, asks to locate the adventurers who signaled for rescue with a red signal flare.

Name: What’s Wrong With Being Overnourished?
DescNotCompleted: Bishan asks the Adventurer to collect medicinal herbs for Yasta.

Name: To Pioneer Farmlands
DescNotCompleted: Instead of payment, Kamiya demands labor and asks you to defeat the monsters.

Name: Blame the Alcohol
DescNotCompleted: Declaring that he will exploit the Adventurer’s labor, Davin asks to collect soil samples.

Name: Earn One’s Keep
DescNotCompleted: Davin asks the Adventurer to get some samples of Starfish Flowers. He says he needs proof to determine if the site can be cleared…

Name: I Make It a Rule to See Things Through
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer helps ‘Shayad’, the Captain of the Guard, take care of the monsters upon Kamiya’s request.

Name: Might As Well Finish The Job
DescNotCompleted: Shayad asks the Adventurer to defeat the monsters in Crimson Shimmer Wastes.

Name: The Type Who Can't Ignore Someone In Need
DescNotCompleted: Shayad shares Quarry Foreman Alborz’s unfortunate situation and asks the Adventurer to help him out.

Name: Duty Calls
DescNotCompleted: After being summoned to the Ashientet Legation by Mueena, the Adventurer hears about Archon Fahad’s suspicious behavior.

Name: How Bothersome
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer tries to decipher the code with Quista, the ‘Sublime Avenger.’

Name: Troubleshooting Specialist
DescNotCompleted: After getting advice from Sarvin the Botanist, the Adventurer deciphers the code with Quista.

Name: A Referral of A Referral
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer helps the Bardad Expedition for Quista.

Name: Whether By Intent Or By Influence
DescNotCompleted: Following Quista’s advice, the Adventurer meets Lilian. While assisting with her research, they discover a wrecked carriage.

Name: You Can’t Hide the Smell
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer looks for clues regarding the missing merchant in the wrecked carriage.

Name: An Abundance of Prey
DescNotCompleted: After delivering all the clues gathered so far, the Adventurer is asked to meet Ramynn in Thundercrest.

Name: No Progress at All
DescNotCompleted: Ramynn asks the Adventurer to locate the infiltrating Wolf Clan amongst the hunters.

Name: Ensure a Clean Finish
