DescNotCompleted: After falling into a trap, the Adventurer defeats the Wolf Clan with Ramynn and goes to the troubled Naruru.

Name: Consequences For Deception
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer helps Marmie, who wants to teach the Wolf Clan a lesson. Ramynn smiles after listening to the whole story from the Adventurer.

Name: There Are No Answers to Making A Living
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer hands a fake Aetherium candy to Zaven. Zaven goes further and asks to get some monster leathers.

Name: A Matter of Right or Wrong
DescNotCompleted: While assisting Zaben, the Adventurer witnesses a secret deal between him and a soldier from the Ascientet Legation.

Name: You Can't See What Lies Beneath the Surface
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer meets Mueena and Azran, who explain what has happened so far.

Name: A Young Butcher on Alert
DescNotCompleted: After hearing Azran’s message with Ramynn, the Adventurer tracks the stolen relic with Orha.

Name: Recklessness Is Not Ambition
DescNotCompleted: Orha suggests luring the Wolf Clan with a fake relic.

Name: Seize Or Be Seized
DescNotCompleted: Ramynn declares that he will join Azran soon, and the Adventurer assists Orha with the Hunters Guild affairs.

Name: Rise From the Fall
DescNotCompleted: At Orha’s request, the Adventurer scouts for an encampment site suitable for flight.

Name: Eyes and Ears
DescNotCompleted: At Mueena’s request, the Adventurer travels to the Gate of Lament and meets Nasser and Chahim.

Name: Same Struggle Regardless
DescNotCompleted: Nasser asks the Adventurer to check the blind spots first, and everywhere the Adventurer goes, they discover Aethereum candies.

Name: Quite Resourceful
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer explains the dangers of Aethereum candy to Foreman Zabin, but Zabin is not easily convinced.

Name: Carrot-flavored Whip
DescNotCompleted: At Nasser’s request, the Adventurer looks for the people who went while putting up waymarkers for miners to travel safely.

Name: Counter Attack
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer receives Azran’s message through Chahim. After meeting with Azran, the Adventurer seeks out Mueena with the evidence and a formal complaint in hand.

Name: Fighting Evil with Evil
DescNotCompleted: Returning to the Gate of Lament, the Adventurer collects ingredients for a poison at Chahim's request.

Name: At Least You’re Still Alive
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer tests the poison on monsters.

Name: Sublime Avenger
DescNotCompleted: Reunited with Azran in the Wolf Clan Hideout, the Adventurer joins forces with him to rescue Quaista.

Name: A Snake Without Its Venomous Fangs
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer and the Sublime Avengers engage in a battle against Fahad. Afterward, Mueena announces that she will become the next Archon.

Name: Dr. Know-It-All Naruru!
DescNotCompleted: The Narurus of Aburu Village are locked in a fierce debate over who will become the next Stoutbeard. Which Naruru is the most suitable?

Name: Will of the God Ea
DescNotCompleted: The Chef Narurus want to share the wonderful dishes showcased at the festival with the other animals.

Name: Naruru Patrol
DescNotCompleted: The Bristly-Hairs are an armed group composed entirely of Narurus. They are always busy scouting the entire Giant's Garden.

Name: The Patrol's Equipment
DescNotCompleted: The Bristly-Hairs are in a bind because their equipment was heavily damaged by the Incursion. Let's show them what an honorary Bristly-Hair can do!

Name: Expedition's Operating Funds I
DescNotCompleted: Most members of the Bardad Expedition endure low pay and constant overtime, driven solely by their passion for learning. Let's gather cacti to help sustain their research.

Name: Expedition's Operating Funds II
DescNotCompleted: The expedition is looking for a new source of revenue. They speculate that Chromatic Pebbles will be a massive hit...!

Name: The Expedition Members' Main Job
DescNotCompleted: Let's clear out the monsters next to the Waypoint to ensure the expedition's research goes smoothly.

Name: The Time-Catching Naruru I
DescNotCompleted: I became fishing buddies with the aloof Naruru by the riverbank. Let's learn step-by-step, starting with how to get bait.

Name: The Time-Catching Naruru II
DescNotCompleted: Following his advice that trap fishing is better than using a rod for beginners, let's cast a trap and catch some fish.

Name: Establishing the Hierarchy
DescNotCompleted: Sometimes, violent ones appear among the Rappies at the ranch. Let's assert dominance over the aggressive Rappies and tame them.

Name: Instead of Saying Goodbye
DescNotCompleted: The rancher wants to make an accessory for the Rappie they are sending away. Let's gather the materials for the accessory ourselves.

Name: The Successor's Dilemma I
DescNotCompleted: Asked to leave a review of the ranch experience business, the Adventurer decides to play as hard as possible!

Name: The Successor's Dilemma II
DescNotCompleted: A new business plan has been proposed. Let's experience a day in the life at the ranch and share some thoughts.

Name: The Successor's Dilemma III
DescNotCompleted: Is the course inside the ranch suitable? Let's ride a Rappie and run the course ourselves to see if it's a good route.

Name: Unbearable Atmosphere
DescNotCompleted: The Encampment has run out of the tree sap needed for medicine, but they are short-handed. Let's climb a tall tree and collect some sap.

Name: The Only One I Trusted
DescNotCompleted: The Narurus at the Encampment are deeply mourning the death of the chatty hunter. Let's help recover his belongings.

Name: Sending Off
DescNotCompleted: The Naruru wants to float a flower on the water as a symbol for his return to the God Ea. It's probably best to keep quiet about the truth regarding the chatty hunter.

Name: A Fairly Renowned Hunter
DescNotCompleted: Another hunter says he is confident he won't lose to anyone. The Adventurer accepts the bet and begins the hunt.

Name: A High-Earning Hunter
DescNotCompleted: The hunter claims to be an expert in treasure hunting as well. Let's accept the challenge and teach the hunter a lesson.

Name: Drunken Confession
DescNotCompleted: The brewery keeper's apprentices start making plans to show off their best skills...

Name: The Path of Brewing
DescNotCompleted: Surprisingly, the apprentices seem to have paid attention in class, as they ask us to get the most important thing: raw materials.

Name: The Basics of Brewing
DescNotCompleted: The ultimate liquor, brewed with heart and soul, is complete. Let's have the master evaluate it!

Name: The Meaning of Brewing
DescNotCompleted: The brewery keeper is brewing a love potion. The Adventurer starts feeling an inexplicable fondness toward the people around them...

Name: Seasonal Business I
DescNotCompleted: Climbing tall trees and gliding has become widely popular among the youth. The merchant asks for help, claiming they lack the funds to pay off their debts.

Name: Seasonal Business II
DescNotCompleted: The merchant designed a cliff gliding course, smiling as they predict that making this popular will sell more Gliders...

Name: Blood of a Distributor
DescNotCompleted: A merchant needs to deliver materials for tailoring. Where can they get the materials in bulk?… How about trying the Paradise Advent Society?

Name: Thicker than Water
DescNotCompleted: The merchant won't say why, but promises to pay generously for robes belonging to the Paradise Advent Society. What could the reason be?

Name: Soft-Bean Adventurers
DescNotCompleted: Azid seems to have been fascinated by a special tale passed down among the Naruru. It's said he even put the Stiffhair Mission on hold and is training hard just for that...

Name: Trial of Courage
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer unexpectedly joins the Softbean Adventuring Party. The first trial a hero candidate must face is none other than the Trial of Courage!

Name: It's Okay to Be Chubby
DescNotCompleted: The Naruru's adorable physique isn't quite suited for Gliding. Shouldn't their Glider be upgraded?

Name: Passed the Trial of Courage?!
DescNotCompleted: What kind of “courage” does Ea desire? Perhaps it is facing an opponent you can never defeat.

Name: Even Humans Are Useful in an Emergency
DescNotCompleted: There are many things in this world that tiny, cute hands cannot break. However, there are even more things those hands can save.

Name: Searching for More Wounded Humans
DescNotCompleted: Victims of the Incursion have been found in an uninhabited area. The Softbean Adventuring Party want to help the injured.

Name: Incursions Strike Anywhere
DescNotCompleted: In a small cave tucked away in the mines, the wounded were hiding and relying on each other. Let's help them evacuate safely.

Name: Sneaking Out Behind the Adults' Backs
DescNotCompleted: Nothing stays a secret forever. What will happen to Azid now that he's been caught sneaking out of the mission area?

Name: Trial of Wisdom
DescNotCompleted: Azid decides to use a clever trick, befitting for a hero candidate. A true hero must step forward without hesitation.

Name: I Feel Full Just Looking at It
DescNotCompleted: Some beings just inspire unconditional love. Let's listen to Sagkala, who claims to like Rappies more than the Adventuring Party.

Name: Oath Beneath the Ash Tree
DescNotCompleted: The Softbean Adventuring Party promised as children to go find Ea together. As they face the true trial, they must reaffirm their resolve.

Name: Ea is Watching!
DescNotCompleted: The hero candidate and the others decide to offer a proper prayer to Ea. Let's help them find the materials needed for the ritual.

Name: Prayers in a Sweet-Smelling Place
DescNotCompleted: God Ea is quite picky. Let's clean up the surroundings to prepare a pristine ritual site.

Name: The Nose Always Works Hard
DescNotCompleted: A foul aura from the adjacent valley ends up ruining the ritual. The Adventuring Party set out to solve the problem at its source.

Name: The Reason Behind the Foul Stench
DescNotCompleted: Azid makes a sharp deduction. Even to a human adventurer, his theory seems highly plausible. Let's defeat the monsters and prove him right.

Name: Cozy Powder
DescNotCompleted: The depth of Ea's plans for the living beings of this star is hard to fathom. Just as Sagkala said, let's restore the valley to its original state.

Name: Trial of Perseverance
DescNotCompleted: The final trial is to prove you are a Naruru with great endurance. What does Azid struggle with the most?

Name: Intoxicated by the Scent Alone
DescNotCompleted: Being highly sensitive also means being vulnerable. Azid and Sagkala end up passing out at the brewery...

Name: Anything for Medicine
DescNotCompleted: A merchant claims that healthy bodies produce healthy medicine. The discomfort is brief, but your wallet will be full.

Name: Flying is No Problem
DescNotCompleted: Waking up from a terrible hangover, Azid wants to retake the trial. This time, he vows to fight the enemies he usually fears.

Name: Good Medicine Tastes Bad and Smells Bitter
DescNotCompleted: Azid shows a strong resolve to endure the bad smell and defeat the sky monsters. Let's help him carry on the Adventuring Party' resolve.

Name: Ea Did Not Choose
DescNotCompleted: The Softbean Adventuring Party' trial is drawing to a close... Will Ea truly look upon them?

Name: Stamina Builds Pioneering Power
DescNotCompleted: The settler village of Hesperia has a Mountaineering Club full of strong-willed people. Start the day full of energy with some hiking.

Name: To Avoid Getting Lost
DescNotCompleted: Harmful creatures on the hiking trail are hindering workout activities, and they are multiplying. Clear them out and resume the hike.

Name: Voluntary Wanderer
DescNotCompleted: A Mountaineering Club member vanished while working on a signpost. Since it's hard to get out of a dense forest alone, the club begins a search operation.

Name: Unpaved Hiking Trail
DescNotCompleted: A proper hiking trail appeared after passing a hill. This place is also unfit for hiking. It looks like it needs another cleanup.

Name: What the Mountaineering Club Does
DescNotCompleted: It seems the Hesperia Mountaineering Club uses hiking as an excuse to do village chores... but they take great pride in it!

Name: The Meaning of the Mountaineering Club
DescNotCompleted: The Mountaineering Club's journey begins now. It's time to clearly understand where the strong mentality of the Hesperia residents comes from.

Name: A Difficult Situation, But…
DescNotCompleted: Nina runs a morning diner. She wants to open the diner in the evening as well to strike while the iron is hot.

Name: No Matter How Urgent
DescNotCompleted: Nina believes food for humans should only use ingredients prepared by humans. Does she have a prejudice against the Naruru?

Name: Even So
DescNotCompleted: Nina is surprised that the quality of the food sold by Kishirashu of the Naruru is unexpectedly good. However, she still says she can't use it in her cooking...

Name: Unexpected Solution
DescNotCompleted: The residents show a lukewarm reaction to Nina's new dish. However, a method to improve it appears from an unexpected place.

Name: A Misunderstanding Resolved by a Minor Event
DescNotCompleted: Hearing that a regular customer of the diner is worried, the Adventurer heads to the Ashen Forest. There, they encounter Gerald and other defense squad members.

Name: Discarding Prejudice Isn't Hard
DescNotCompleted: Driven by worry, Nina follows them and is surprised to see the defense squad overcome a crisis thanks to Kishirashu, and delightfully eating the dish made according to Kishirashu's advice...

Name: Understand the Enemy's Psychology
DescNotCompleted: Why do the Kuduru target supply boxes? Do they prefer stealing over destroying reconnaissance outposts?

Name: Wide Open Outpost
DescNotCompleted: To stop thieves, doors must be locked tightly. But the Hesperia Reconnaissance Outpost is just too easy to break into!

Name: Extremely Precious Stone
DescNotCompleted: Thieves only have eyes for valuables. Let's use the Kuduru's psychology against them.

Name: Sweet Medicine Is…
DescNotCompleted: Josephine sells medicine at the Frantia Gate. She is in a tough spot because she ran out of medicinal herbs for a picky customer.

Name: Medicinal Herbs from the Optimal Environment
DescNotCompleted: Honey harvested from a bee's body is hard to refine. The real honey seems to be in the place the bees cherish the most.

Name: What the High-Ranking Person Seeks
DescNotCompleted: Josephine's revenue comes from a secret sweet pill with side effects. And the identity of her somewhat high-ranking customer is...

Name: Our Commander Is…
DescNotCompleted: Commander Lena of the Knights of the Biting Wind. The apprentice knights, completely captivated by her martial prowess, are dreaming of a shining future.

Name: Worthy to Fight Together
DescNotCompleted: Ophelia and Sophie both want to jump into actual combat without delay, neither willing to yield. The Adventurer, caught between them, has to judge who is better...

Name: Childish Fight
DescNotCompleted: The two fighers are neck and neck, making it difficult to determine the winner. However, the apprentice knights rush out to the field again to claim honor.

Name: A Father's Grief
DescNotCompleted: The residents of Hesperia aren't the only ones suffering from the evil deeds of the Ironblood Brigade. Let's help a father who fled from Stormkel.

Name: Evil Deeds That Must Never Repeat
DescNotCompleted: Jesper wants to borrow the adventurer's strength to rescue his daughter before she is sold off as merchandise.

Name: No More Merchandise
DescNotCompleted: The Ironblood Brigade still seems to be riding high even after being wiped out once. We must stop them from trafficking people ever again.

Name: Muddy Water Doesn't Clear Itself
DescNotCompleted: The Knights of the Frostwind volunteered to leave the Frantia Kingdom, but they all have their own stories. What reason led the Magitech Engineer Jean to leave?

Name: An Anomaly, or a Secret Experiment?
DescNotCompleted: Jean says there's a reason for the aperiodic explosions occurring at the Hallowed Obsidian Mountain. Does that mean it wasn't the work of that Apostle?

Name: The Mind Behind the Blade
DescNotCompleted: Jean expresses his regrets to the Frantia Gate Garrison. He prepares a surprise gift for them.

Name: Who Bears the Burden of Sorrow?
DescNotCompleted: Let's hear the story of Parneia, who is living in depression after losing her Rappie...

Name: How to Accept Loss
DescNotCompleted: It seems impossible to overcome the guilt with ordinary methods. Let's seek help from an expert.

Name: In All the Time We Spent Together
DescNotCompleted: Under the guidance of Tilmun, the caretaker at the Rappie Training Ground, Parneia finishes saying her goodbyes to the Rappie.

Name: The Meaning of a Haven for All
DescNotCompleted: Consul Lorraine, who came from Frantia, plans to tour the entire Pulsing Ridge. She seems to want to check how the residents are living first.

Name: What Cannot Be Done with Sharp Claws
DescNotCompleted: Hesperia Village is full of vulnerabilities everywhere. However, with no money or supplies, they must be dealt with using manpower.

Name: Waterfall of Thunder
DescNotCompleted: Sometimes "thunder" is used as a metaphor for an unbearable roar. No one really knows if thunder actually struck this waterfall.

Name: Buried Time
DescNotCompleted: At the southernmost tip of the hills lies a hidden cave. Lorraine does not want to miss any of the debris buried there.

Name: Gaze of the Fugitive
DescNotCompleted: Even a rat flees to a sunny spot. Let's chase after the cornered monster.

Name: Cleaning is for Those Who Come After
DescNotCompleted: Lorraine judged the cave requires further investigation. The task for the Adventurer, her investigator, is to show off their cleaning skills.

Name: If it Can Sprout Anywhere
DescNotCompleted: The botanist from Enkia wants to make flowers bloom even on the Forsaken Land. When told the chances are low, he gets incredibly furious...

Name: Flowers Bloom and Fall
DescNotCompleted: There is a lot of work to do to make the seven-colored flower bloom. Let's help the botanist tend to the field.

Name: If We Had to Find God
DescNotCompleted: The temple structures of the Thunderfall Ridges are located in hard-to-explain places. What kind of purpose is hidden behind this?

Name: Rappies Hate Loud Noises
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer has arrived at the Rappie Training Ground to complete a request from the Naruru. What is the reason they need a magical tool?

Name: They are Bound to Break Unexpectedly
DescNotCompleted: Jean wants to prevent the magical tools from being destroyed by the monsters' rampage. Let's help him find the optimal location.

Name: Need a Powerful Hit
DescNotCompleted: The Naruru try to sense danger at once using their sense of smell. Let's deliver the pungent-smelling flower to Jean.

Name: A Place That Used to Be Someone's Home
DescNotCompleted: Lorraine says that people need a place to live besides Hesperia. Let's investigate the suitability of the old site of the ruined kingdom.

Name: Highly Visible Relics
DescNotCompleted: The historian in the ruins has been pinned down while being chased by monsters. Let's recover his relics for him.

Name: Escape Quickly and Swiftly
DescNotCompleted: The historian now wants to move to another place and requests a path to be cleared. Let's defeat the monsters in the ruins once more.

Name: Fueling Passion
DescNotCompleted: Through Lorraine's generous judgment, the historian gets a chance to investigate further. Lorraine also plans to survey the west side of the ruins.

Name: This House is That House, and That House is This House
DescNotCompleted: The historian seems to be lost again. How did the citizens of Karadia find their own houses?

Name: Yummy Delicious Vegetarian Cuisine
DescNotCompleted: This time, the monsters chose to eat the flowers instead of trampling them. Are the flowers grown by the botanist himself fascinating even to monsters?

Name: Slowly Disappearing Seawater
DescNotCompleted: Corin, whom we have met again, is searching for the cause of the sea level drop. Let's help Corin, who has been staying up all night for days.

Name: Follow the Laws of Nature
DescNotCompleted: To investigate the relic from the ruins, an Aether reaction experiment must be conducted first. Let's secure Aether from the monsters.

Name: End of the Ridge Exploration
DescNotCompleted: The Bardad Expedition Garrison is the final destination of this exploration. Once Jean's errand is complete, will the Adventurer be free from Lorraine?

Name: Stay, I'll Treat You Well
DescNotCompleted: At the request of Outpost Drill Instructor Katrina, the Adventurer eliminates monsters plaguing the recruits.

Name: You're the Only One I Trust
DescNotCompleted: Katrina asks the Adventurer to be her comrade-in-arms and help determine what else to include in the training manual.

Name: Walking on a Bed of Roses
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer helps an exhausted carpenter in repairing a bridge and crafting gifts for the recruits.

Name: I Hear Your Voice
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer takes the plunge for a cook who wants to find love but is too terrified to jump down the waterfall himself.

Name: I Want to Break Free
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer helps recruits attempt a getaway disguised as an elopement. Could they reach a safe haven?

Name: Love Potion
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer receives a commission to track down the Phantom Vault. But it was just the beginning...

Name: If It Makes Money, I'll Sell Anything
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer fetches water from various locations for Ninda, who frets over the hot springs' future.

Name: Popular Fluff
DescNotCompleted: Staking the honor of the Fluffs, the Adventurer helps Ninda in her struggles to run the hot springs.

Name: You Said Shiny Is Good
DescNotCompleted: Yielding to Ninda's nagging, the poor-sighted Schulmann asks the Adventurer to fetch something shiny.

Name: Hoarding Other People's Stuff
DescNotCompleted: Commissioned by Karl, the Adventurer uncovers the identities of the thieves embezzling materials in the Gray Forest.

Name: Trust Your Instincts
DescNotCompleted: Medic Penya asks the Adventurer to investigate the Aetherium candy.

Name: Secret Mission
DescNotCompleted: At Penya's behest, the Adventurer gathers Aetherium candy in the Gray Forest and seeks out Luke.

Name: It's Too Early to Relax
DescNotCompleted: As requested by Luke, the Adventurer investigates whether there is any Aetherium candy in Astrid's Citadel.

Name: Flying Into Enemy Lines
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer meets up with Zed, who has infiltrated Astrid's Citadel, and escapes with the Aetherium candy.

Name: Because it's Justice
DescNotCompleted: Three people unite to enrich the lives at the outpost. With Zed's help, the Adventurer secures the supplies.

Name: Repair Tent
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer mends the tents so the patients can stay warm.

Name: Looking Gloomy
DescNotCompleted: Life is supposed to be dreary at the Repose, but a change of pace is necessary. At the scholar's suggestion, the Adventurer joins in a dance.

Name: Let My Skills Do the Talking
DescNotCompleted: An Aetherium addict challenges the Adventurer to a duel. Who will emerge victorious?

Name: Sorrow Doubles When Shared
DescNotCompleted: At the request of Firiz, who is managing the camp in place of a heartbroken Vahista, the Adventurer fetches winter gear.

Name: Always Short on Budget
DescNotCompleted: Firiz vows to forge her own path. As her first test subject, the Adventurer flies along the ruins.

Name: I Want to be a Shiny-Head
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer helps Umun, who yearns to be a Shiny-Head, and comforts Vahista.

Name: Can you handle this?
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer reunites with the Stormkel Administrator and helps him find the missing seal.

Name: You Are My Companion
DescNotCompleted: Having cast aside all shame, Lars asks the Adventurer to deploy carrier pigeons.

Name: You Don't Like Me, Do You?
DescNotCompleted: At Gerda's request, the Adventurer tests out a self-defense object.

Name: Streamlined Administration
DescNotCompleted: While distributing the self-defense objects, the Adventurer learns about the inner situation of the Gate.

Name: What We Want to Protect
DescNotCompleted: Blacksmith Haken asks the Adventurer to defeat the monsters near the Gate so he can play hide-and-seek with his daughter.

Name: Change Starts Small
DescNotCompleted: Intrigued by the Paradise Advent Society's doctrine, Viana asks the Adventurer to procure a book for her.

Name: A Soldier's Duty
DescNotCompleted: Harald, who guards the Crossroads Shelter, asks the Adventurer to help safely intercept the Paradise Advent Society followers.

Name: A Hidden Talent
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer helps Medic Karis by delivering ingredients for a new medicine.

Name: Ignite the Artistic Soul
DescNotCompleted: After accepting Agani's commission, the Adventurer helps craft goods to sell to followers heading to the Paradise Advent Society's sanctum.

Name: I Don't Want to Lose My Fur
DescNotCompleted: Schulmann is worried sick over his missing nephew. The Adventurer defeats monsters to ensure the nephew's safe return.

Name: Stagnant Water Rots
DescNotCompleted: Ninda tells the Adventurer the whereabouts of Schulmann's nephew. Taking Ninda's gift, the Adventurer heads to the Obsidian Encampment.

Name: I Deserted Too
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer meets Schulmann's nephew, Nisir, who declares he’ll leave the Angry Tail to become a Deserter Tail and explore new lands.

Name: The Water My Body Needs
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer purifies the puddle using Ea's special method, deciding it's best to keep the results hidden from Nisir.

Name: Endless Trouble
DescNotCompleted: Having become Nisir's Companion No. 2, the Adventurer spots Astrid's soldiers prowling near the encampment.

Name: Fatigue Violation
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer meets Ragne, Nisir's Companion No. 1, and slowly gets roped into her unhealthy habits.

Name: Endless Desire
DescNotCompleted: Ragne is wracked with anxiety over Astrid's soldiers. The Adventurer takes up arms for the sake of her mental health.

Name: Finders Keepers
DescNotCompleted: Ragne asks the Adventurer to search near the bridge, warning that other deserters may still be wandering around.

Name: An Open Secret
DescNotCompleted: At Ragne's request, the Adventurer seeks out Tory at the outpost. As if expecting them, Tory entrusts the Adventurer with a task...

Name: A Mutually Exploitative Relationship
DescNotCompleted: Elbi from the Spring-Water Raven Academic Society makes the Adventurer mine for ore.

Name: Driven to Madness
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer encounters an anomaly while mining. Elbi tells them to find Casper and report the incident.

Name: A Yearning Being
DescNotCompleted: Casper wishes to use the visual recording device to craft an otherworldly artifact. The Adventurer helps him gather ingredients for the preservative fluid.

Name: Mutual Trust
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer meets Karis at the Crossroads Shelter, who readily agrees to help craft the preservative fluid.

Name: Everything is Connected
DescNotCompleted: Karis suggests the Adventurer seek out someone living in the Blizzard's Breath Plain.

Name: The Final Goodbye
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer examines the visual recording device with Beatrice. Spotting a familiar face, they promise to meet each other again.

Name: The Longest Shadow
DescNotCompleted: Following Beatrice's advice, the Adventurer heads to the Alabaster Encampment. There, they encounter Ingmar, Astrid's subordinate.

Name: Tough as Nails
DescNotCompleted: Ignorant of the Adventurer's true identity, Ingmar puts them through special training for new recruits.

Name: No Such Thing as a Kind Northerner
DescNotCompleted: After gathering monster hides and finding Haildi, the Adventurer unexpectedly becomes a recruit candidate.

Name: An Ominous Premonition
DescNotCompleted: After hearing Haildi explain why they forge armaments, the Adventurer clears up their misunderstanding about Astrid.

Name: The Hidden Side
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer defeats nearby monsters so this location can serve as an outpost against the Paradise Advent Society.

Name: In the Name of Honor
DescNotCompleted: The Adventurer clashes with Astrid once again, reaffirming that it is time to walk their chosen paths.

Name: To Claim the Bounty
DescNotCompleted: Ranon confidently taunts the Adventurer, boasting about what lies at the core of Krea-style bounty hunting.

Name: Keeping the Name and Legacy Alive
DescNotCompleted: To claim a bounty, hunters must submit proof to the client. When hunting, it is crucial to mask one's presence and strike vital spots.

Name: In the Eyes of the Great Seta
DescNotCompleted: Seta ridicules Ranon’s approach, pursuing ruthless hunting methods instead. He stirs up conflict whenever he opens his mouth.

Name: Rude for Rude
DescNotCompleted: Seta opposes and disregards other schools, claiming that the new hunting method from the Krea mainland is the only correct path.

Name: An Equal Start
DescNotCompleted: To shatter Seta's stubbornness, Ranon proposes a hunting match, only to notice that Seta is already injured in the shoulder and side.

Name: Kill Them Before They Kill You
DescNotCompleted: At Ranon's request for a fair match, the Adventurer gathers water and herbs for Seta, but it hurts Seta’s pride and she lashes out in anger.

Name: Stupid Is as Stupid Does
DescNotCompleted: Ranon proposes a hunting competition in a limited area, igniting a race between the two to claim a high-ground ambush point.

Name: Fooled Twice, Fooled Thrice
DescNotCompleted: Seta falls behind trying to climb a cliff in a straight line due to injuries, allowing Ranon to cleverly use structures and claim the high ground first.

Name: Follow the Law of Might
DescNotCompleted: Infuriated by Seta’s refusal to accept the results, Ranon loses her temper, and the two clash in a fierce fight.

Name: The Weight of the Past
DescNotCompleted: Hakan, a veteran warrior, is committed to protecting the Elysium. But his chronic illness flares up, forcing him to ask the Adventurer for emergency medicine.

Name: Beliefs of the Eastern Kingdoms
DescNotCompleted: Impressed by the Adventurer’s exceptional monster-hunting skills, Hakan subtly suggests joining the Hunters Guild, sharing stories of how he used to train his successors in the past.

Name: Above the Flowing Clouds
DescNotCompleted: Hakan praises the Adventurer, noting the Adventurer’s outstanding instinct and ability to handle unexpected viarables that despite a lack of formal training.

Name: Old Soldier's Memories I
DescNotCompleted: Against a scenic backdrop, Hakan shares his grim past—how he became the sole survivor against the monsters while crossing Krea, and the sacrifices of his comrades.

Name: Old Soldier's Memories II
DescNotCompleted: To convey the sheer brutality of the past, Hakan brings the 'survival hunt' to the Adventurer—a challenge to face endless waves of monsters until their momentum breaks.

Name: Old Soldier's Memories III
DescNotCompleted: Hakan shares the grueling methods they used to cook food after battle: boil tree bark and grass using heated stones to maintain body temperature.

Name: Tales of Old Times I
DescNotCompleted: After crafting the horrific field rations, Hakan calmly recalls the past—the sleepless night watches and tireless combats endured until reaching the safe house.

Name: Tales of Old Times II
DescNotCompleted: Hakan issues the final task: to choose the safest spot to camp by surveying the terrain, aiming to broaden the Adventurer's horizons.

Name: Tales of Old Times III
DescNotCompleted: The ordeal concludes with an all-out hunt, and Hakan smiles peacefully, expressing pride in the current Guild Master Kian and the fellow members who branched out into various factions.

Name: Someone's Small Field
DescNotCompleted: Narim, a novice farmer, earnestly begs for help, reporting that monsters are crossing over to trample the crops on his field that cost a fortune.

Name: No Way to Be Promoted
DescNotCompleted: Narim confesses to his lack of sword skills, which forced him to give up on promotion in the Krea army. Now, he farms on the side, saving up funds to build a peaceful farmstead.

Name: Stable Livelihood
DescNotCompleted: Narim criticizes the empire's aggression, pointing to the history where they destroyed the Kingdom of Susia simply for provisions.

Name: Warmonger
DescNotCompleted: Meanwhile, Ozge, an ecologist dispatched from the Krea mainland, vents frustration over the lack of support due to the empire's pure focus on military force.

Name: Slighted Intellectual
DescNotCompleted: Even if the research seems futile, Ozge shows firm resolve. The ecologist is determined to prove why an intellectual's purpose is absolutely essential to Krea.

Name: Overconfident or Ignorant
DescNotCompleted: Ozge worries that after conquering the east, Krea will inevitably push into the Elysium by force.

Name: Who Is the Odd One Out?
DescNotCompleted: To study the natural state of Aether from the Incursion, Ozge asks the Adventurer to gather Aether samples around the Tesseract.

Name: Reach of the Incursion
DescNotCompleted: Ozge harbors doubts about why the monsters spawned by an Incursion are even more ferocious than the ones inside the Tower.

Name: To Break Through the Grim Reality
DescNotCompleted: Recalling the ancient Bruherian sorcery of physical control, Ozge hypothesizes that the Tower's Aether forcibly controls the monsters' will.

Name: Dance of Harmony and Communion
DescNotCompleted: Shahnaz, facing the Hunters Guild admission trial, misunderstood a Romantic Hunter's advice and attempts an absurd hunt—attracting monsters' attention with dance and song.

Name: Fooled by a Dashing Face
DescNotCompleted: Shahnaz realizes the truth behind the Romantic Hunter Uran's boast about dancing with monsters, and immediately sinks into deep embarrassment.

Name: Another Branch, New Opportunity
DescNotCompleted: Shaking off the embarrassment, Shahnaz shows interest in the 'Treasure Hunter' faction, which focuses on tracking and treasure hunting, and seeks further advice.

Name: My True Calling
DescNotCompleted: Realizing that treasure hunting isn't a good fit, Shahnaz decides to create a unique faction, encouraged by the Adventurer's advice that there is no need to follow traditional paths.

Name: Moonlight Hunter
DescNotCompleted: Shahnaz devises a grand faction called the 'Moonlight Hunter'—a style that maximizes stealth and senses to assassinate monsters in the blink of an eye.

Name: Moonfall Flowers and Deep Sleep
DescNotCompleted: Insisting on the necessity of deep sleep during the day for night hunting, Shahnaz consumes brewed Moonfall Flowers—a plant with powerful sleep-inducing properties—laying the founding principles of the Moonlight Hunter.

Name: Visual Shock
DescNotCompleted: Deciding that abstract symbols cannot capture people's attention, Shahnaz begins contemplating a new approach.

Name: Beast Among Beasts
DescNotCompleted: When Shahnaz's cat disappears into a dangerous underground clearing, the hunter asks the Adventurer to distract the monsters and ventures down to rescue the feline.

Name: Disguise for a Predator
DescNotCompleted: The adventurer and Shahnaz attempt to disguise the cat as a Moonlight Hunter, only to end up scratched by its claws.

Name: Every Small Life Matters
DescNotCompleted: An old man named Bau seeks help to drive back the monsters threatening the merchant caravan's trade route.

Name: A Deserving Soul
DescNotCompleted: Worried about a stray cat that constantly wanders outside, Bau attempts to attach a bell to it, but the creature swiftly escapes.

Name: Just Watching Over
DescNotCompleted: Instead of toys, Bau decides to plant grass that the cat loves to rub against, a quiet gesture wishing for the feline to play freely and stay safe.

Name: Seeing Things
DescNotCompleted: Duren, an arcanist from Frantia, seems to have fallen under a self-inflicted illusion spell while researching magic to weaken monsters.

Name: One Last Time
DescNotCompleted: Shunned in Frantia for his slurred speech and gloomy attitude, Duren found warmth in the Elysium. Deeply moved, the arcanist now wishes to repay the villagers.

Name: What Children Learn
DescNotCompleted: During the Adventurer's brief absence, a horde of monsters ambushed the village. While some were left injured in the forest, those who fled to the high grounds have yet to return.

Name: Coercion and Persuasion
DescNotCompleted: With the chaos behind them, Duren shares rumors of a suspicious group recently preaching about 'Tan' and frantically persuading the villagers.

Name: Altar of the Ashen Crows
DescNotCompleted: The two learn that the Ashen Crows have set up a suspicious altar on the forest outskirts, near where an amnesiac villager was recently rescued.

Name: Frenzy Spell
DescNotCompleted: After destroying the altar and dismantling its magic circuit, Duren discovers that it is a forbidden 'frenzy spell' that drives living creatures mad.

Name: Traces of the Dragons
DescNotCompleted: Warrior Tion came to the Elysium seeking to make a name by slaying a dragon, but has yet to spot a single one.

Name: A Warrior Never Backs Down
DescNotCompleted: Denying the common belief that dragons are extinct, Tion stages a bizarre spectacle based on ancient records—piling up a mountain of treasure and waiting for a dragon to appear.

Name: Venting Frustration
DescNotCompleted: When the operation that cost a fortune fails completely, the warrior hunts monsters to blow off steam.

Name: Stage Without Spectators
DescNotCompleted: Tion hears that the Ashen Crows are disrupting the village and resolves to demonstrate a warrior's spirit. After all, the warrior’s true purpose is self-discipline.

Name: A Matter of Belief
DescNotCompleted: Tion reasons that the villagers' indifference to martial prowess stems from a lack of public safety and widespread starvation.

Name: Reaching Out Again
DescNotCompleted: Facing the harsh reality, Tion dispels the illusion of dragon hunting and teams up with the Adventurer to procure food and weapons.

Name: No Use If You Are Dead
DescNotCompleted: As a mountain of work piles up after her colleague Vedat caused an explosion, Devora seeks the Adventurer's help.

Name: The Danger of Being Too Familiar
DescNotCompleted: After making a clumsy mistake during the measurement, Devora sneaks out the old equipment confiscated by Chedar to try again.

Name: Running Away Together
DescNotCompleted: Terrified by the news that Chedar is coming to the site, Devora secretly asks the Adventurer to retrieve the illegally installed old equipment while she distracts Chedar.

Name: Only in Numbers
DescNotCompleted: After scolding Devora's petty trick, Chedar seeks to hire the Adventurer as a mercenary for the expedition.

Name: Legacy of the Privileged
DescNotCompleted: Chedar examines the artifact that distorts space and suspects it is a terraforming tool used by an ancient civilization.

Name: An Inevitable Sin
DescNotCompleted: Chedar requests a subjugation mission from the Adventurer, explaining that the monsters are attacking the outpost because they were provoked during the establishment of the expedition base.

Name: A Debt of Gratitude
DescNotCompleted: Before heading home, the elderly Cave Owls meet the Adventurer once again and express their deepest gratitude for saving them.

Name: A Matter of Conscience
DescNotCompleted: Chedar uses self-defense magic to clear the paths and protect the vulnerable Cave Owl residents on their journey back home.

Name: An Overbudget Reward
DescNotCompleted: Just as the refugees depart and everyone feels relieved, a report arrives that a monster horde is swarming the outpost.

Name: The Boss Has No Idea
DescNotCompleted: Sidelined and under disciplinary action for causing trouble, Vedat resents Chedar for doing nothing to keeping them safe, and begs the Adventurer to tag along.

Name: Researchers Aren't Mercenaries
DescNotCompleted: After burying the devices, Vedat tells the Adventurer about an ancient artifact known as the Monolith. He is convinced that the Elysium’s bizarre climate is caused by its influence.

Name: Doing What I'm Told... For Now
DescNotCompleted: Wary of getting tangled up with the Krea gate garrison, Vedat uses the Adventurer to discreetly clear out the monsters guarding the path to the lake.

Name: A Necessary Alternative
DescNotCompleted: Thanks to the Adventurer's exceptional ether sensitivity, Vedat successfully tracks down the tiny artifact fragments that would have otherwise been missed.

Name: An Ancestral Faith
DescNotCompleted: Vedat develops a hypothesis that the reason the Cave Owls worship the lake is directly linked to their ancestors from the Tan Kingdom.

Name: Connected Hearts
DescNotCompleted: Torn between bittersweet feelings and intellectual curiosity, Vedat decides to call it a day and heads back to the outpost.

Name: Too Good to Be True
DescNotCompleted: Driven by her deep distrust toward humans, Sahinia takes the Adventurer for a spy, refusing to believe any friendship with the Bristly-Hair Naruru.

Name: Naruru’s Judgment
DescNotCompleted: Sahinia remains hostile, but seeing how the Adventurer cares about nature as Goddess Ea’s gift, grants a chance to prove their friendship.

Name: Fierce and Unyielding
DescNotCompleted: Seeing the Adventurer's sincerity, Sahinia presents the first trial to prove the Adventurer's skills to the other Angry Tail comrades.

Name: Seeking Approval
DescNotCompleted: Sahinia declares that she will completely drop all suspicions once the Adventurer earns recognition from three fellow members.

Name: Strict Evaluation
DescNotCompleted: Before facing the members who hold even stricter standards than Sahinia, the Adventurer begins a more rigorous training.

Name: The Way of the Angry Tail
DescNotCompleted: When the three comrades don't show up, Sahinia asks the Adventurer to seek them out in person.

Name: Naruru of Wind
DescNotCompleted: Zabiya, an Angry-Tail scout, believes that humans are far too sluggish to ever keep pace with the Naruru.

Name: Naruru of Sunlight
DescNotCompleted: Shamashak, an Angry Tail vanguard, values an unyielding fighting spirit above all else.

Name: Naruru of Steel
DescNotCompleted: Bari, a solemn guardian, demands unbreakable, rock-solid fortitude.
